+def _local_package_managers() -> dict:
+    """PATH 탐색과 실행 가능한 승인 별칭 경로를 분리해 반환한다."""
+    managers = {}
+    for name in ("winget", "choco", "scoop"):
+        path_lookup = _run(["where.exe", name])
+        executable = None
+        discovery = "none"
+        probe = None
+        if path_lookup["exit_code"] == 0 and path_lookup["stdout"]:
+            executable = path_lookup["stdout"].splitlines()[0]
+            discovery = "PATH"
+        elif name == "winget" and WINGET_FALLBACK.is_file():
+            fallback_probe = _run([str(WINGET_FALLBACK), "--version"])
+            if fallback_probe["exit_code"] == 0:
+                executable = str(WINGET_FALLBACK)
+                discovery = "windowsapps_alias"
+                probe = fallback_probe
+        if executable and probe is None:
+            probe_args = [executable, "--version"] if name != "choco" else [executable, "--version"]
+            probe = _run(probe_args)
+        available = bool(executable and probe and probe["exit_code"] == 0)
+        managers[name] = {
+            "name": name,
+            "path_lookup": path_lookup,
+            "discovery": discovery if available else "none",
+            "executable": _redact(executable) if available else "없음",
+            "probe": probe,
+            "available": available,
+        }
+    return managers

+def _package_id(manager: str, stdout: str, candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    """패키지 관리자의 기계 판독 가능한 출력에서 패키지 ID를 읽는다."""
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return matches[0] if matches else None
+    if manager == "choco":
+        for line in stdout.splitlines():
+            package_id = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip()
+            if package_id.lower() == candidate.lower():
+                return package_id
+        return None
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        token = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if token.lower() == candidate.lower():
+            return token
+    return None
 
 
+def _query_command(manager: str, executable: str, candidate: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [
+            executable,
+            "search",
+            "--query",
+            candidate,
+            "--source",
+            "winget",
+            "--accept-source-agreements",
+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", candidate, "--exact", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", candidate]

+def _invocation_executable(display_executable: str) -> str:
+    if LOCAL_APPDATA:
+        return display_executable.replace("%LOCALAPPDATA%", LOCAL_APPDATA)
+    return display_executable

+def _query_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict) -> dict:
+    """기존 로컬 패키지 관리자에서 SAT 후보별 회답을 반환한다."""
+    rows = {}
+    for candidate in SAT_CANDIDATES:
+        queries = []
+        selected = None
+        for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+            if not manager_row["available"]:
+                continue
+            executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+            args = _query_command(manager, executable, candidate)
+            result = _run(args)
+            package_id = _package_id(manager, result["stdout"], candidate)
+            query = {
+                "manager": manager,
+                "command": result["command"],
+                "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
+                "stdout": result["stdout"],
+                "stderr": result["stderr"],
+                "package_id": package_id,
+                "available": result["exit_code"] == 0 and package_id is not None,
+            }
+            queries.append(query)
+            if selected is None and query["available"]:
+                selected = query
+        rows[candidate] = {
+            "package_queries": queries,
+            "available": selected is not None,
+            "package_manager": selected["manager"] if selected else None,
+            "package_id": selected["package_id"] if selected else None,
+        }
+    return rows
+

+def _installed_winget_executable(package_id: str, executable_name: str) -> Path | None:

+def _install_command(manager: str, executable: str, package_id: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":

+def install_available_sat_candidates(report: dict) -> list[dict]:
+    """확보 가능 후보 전건을 설치하고 후보별 재측정을 반환한다."""

+                    "experiments/pvsnp/smoke/evidence/environment-changes.json"
+                ],
+            }
+        )

+def _local_package_managers() -> dict:
+    """PATH 탐색과 실행 가능한 승인 별칭 경로를 분리해 반환한다."""
+    managers = {}
+    for name in ("winget", "choco", "scoop"):
+        path_lookup = _run(["where.exe", name])
+        executable = None
+        discovery = "none"
+        probe = None
+        if path_lookup["exit_code"] == 0 and path_lookup["stdout"]:
+            executable = path_lookup["stdout"].splitlines()[0]
+            discovery = "PATH"
+        elif name == "winget" and WINGET_FALLBACK.is_file():
+            fallback_probe = _run([str(WINGET_FALLBACK), "--version"])
+            if fallback_probe["exit_code"] == 0:
+                executable = str(WINGET_FALLBACK)
+                discovery = "windowsapps_alias"
+                probe = fallback_probe
+        if executable and probe is None:
+            probe_args = [executable, "--version"] if name != "choco" else [executable, "--version"]
+            probe = _run(probe_args)
+        available = bool(executable and probe and probe["exit_code"] == 0)
+        managers[name] = {
+            "name": name,
+            "path_lookup": path_lookup,
+            "discovery": discovery if available else "none",
+            "executable": _redact(executable) if available else "없음",
+            "probe": probe,
+            "available": available,
+        }
+    return managers
+
+
+def _package_id(manager: str, stdout: str, candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    """패키지 관리자의 기계 판독 가능한 출력에서 패키지 ID를 읽는다."""
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return matches[0] if matches else None
+    if manager == "choco":
+        for line in stdout.splitlines():
+            package_id = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip()
+            if package_id.lower() == candidate.lower():
+                return package_id
+        return None
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        token = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if token.lower() == candidate.lower():
+            return token
+    return None
 
 
+def _query_command(manager: str, executable: str, candidate: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [
+            executable,
+            "search",
+            "--query",
+            candidate,
+            "--source",
+            "winget",
+            "--accept-source-agreements",
+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", candidate, "--exact", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", candidate]
+
+
+def _invocation_executable(display_executable: str) -> str:
+    if LOCAL_APPDATA:
+        return display_executable.replace("%LOCALAPPDATA%", LOCAL_APPDATA)
+    return display_executable

+def _query_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict) -> dict:
+    """기존 로컬 패키지 관리자에서 SAT 후보별 회답을 반환한다."""
+    rows = {}
+    for candidate in SAT_CANDIDATES:
+        queries = []
+        selected = None
+        for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+            if not manager_row["available"]:
+                continue
+            executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+            args = _query_command(manager, executable, candidate)
+            result = _run(args)
+            package_id = _package_id(manager, result["stdout"], candidate)
+            query = {
+                "manager": manager,
+                "command": result["command"],
+                "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
+                "stdout": result["stdout"],
+                "stderr": result["stderr"],
+                "package_id": package_id,
+                "available": result["exit_code"] == 0 and package_id is not None,
+            }
+            queries.append(query)
+            if selected is None and query["available"]:
+                selected = query
+        rows[candidate] = {
+            "package_queries": queries,
+            "available": selected is not None,
+            "package_manager": selected["manager"] if selected else None,
+            "package_id": selected["package_id"] if selected else None,
+        }
+    return rows
+

+def _installed_winget_executable(package_id: str, executable_name: str) -> Path | None:
+    package_root = Path(LOCAL_APPDATA) / "Microsoft" / "WinGet" / "Packages"
+    if not package_root.is_dir():
+        return None

+def _measure_sat_candidate(name: str) -> dict:

+def _install_command(manager: str, executable: str, package_id: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [
+            executable,
+            "install",
+            "--id",

+            "--exact",
+            "--source",

+            "--accept-source-agreements",
+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "install", package_id, "--yes", "--no-progress"]
+    return [executable, "install", package_id]

+def install_available_sat_candidates(report: dict) -> list[dict]:
+    """확보 가능 후보 전건을 설치하고 후보별 재측정을 반환한다."""

+        remeasurement = _measure_sat_candidate(candidate)

+                "source_coordinates": [
+                    "experiments/pvsnp/smoke/evidence/environment-changes.json"
+                ],
+            }
+        )
+    return events

+def _local_package_managers() -> dict:
+    """PATH 탐색과 실행 가능한 승인 별칭 경로를 분리해 반환한다."""
+    managers = {}
+    for name in ("winget", "choco", "scoop"):
+        path_lookup = _run(["where.exe", name])
+        executable = None
+        discovery = "none"
+        probe = None
+        if path_lookup["exit_code"] == 0 and path_lookup["stdout"]:
+            executable = path_lookup["stdout"].splitlines()[0]
+            discovery = "PATH"
+        elif name == "winget" and WINGET_FALLBACK.is_file():
+            fallback_probe = _run([str(WINGET_FALLBACK), "--version"])
+            if fallback_probe["exit_code"] == 0:
+                executable = str(WINGET_FALLBACK)
+                discovery = "windowsapps_alias"
+                probe = fallback_probe
+        if executable and probe is None:
+            probe_args = [executable, "--version"] if name != "choco" else [executable, "--version"]
+            probe = _run(probe_args)
+        available = bool(executable and probe and probe["exit_code"] == 0)
+        managers[name] = {
+            "name": name,
+            "path_lookup": path_lookup,
+            "discovery": discovery if available else "none",
+            "executable": _redact(executable) if available else "없음",
+            "probe": probe,
+            "available": available,
+        }
+    return managers
+
+
+def _package_id(manager: str, stdout: str, candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    """패키지 관리자의 기계 판독 가능한 출력에서 패키지 ID를 읽는다."""
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return matches[0] if matches else None
+    if manager == "choco":
+        for line in stdout.splitlines():
+            package_id = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip()
+            if package_id.lower() == candidate.lower():
+                return package_id
+        return None
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        token = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if token.lower() == candidate.lower():
+            return token
+    return None
 
 
+def _query_command(manager: str, executable: str, candidate: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [
+            executable,
+            "search",
+            "--query",
+            candidate,
+            "--source",
+            "winget",
+            "--accept-source-agreements",
+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", candidate, "--exact", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", candidate]
+

+def _invocation_executable(display_executable: str) -> str:
+    if LOCAL_APPDATA:
+        return display_executable.replace("%LOCALAPPDATA%", LOCAL_APPDATA)
+    return display_executable

+def _query_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict) -> dict:
+    """기존 로컬 패키지 관리자에서 SAT 후보별 회답을 반환한다."""
+    rows = {}
+    for candidate in SAT_CANDIDATES:
+        queries = []
+        selected = None
+        for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+            if not manager_row["available"]:
+                continue
+            executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+            args = _query_command(manager, executable, candidate)
+            result = _run(args)
+            package_id = _package_id(manager, result["stdout"], candidate)
+            query = {
+                "manager": manager,
+                "command": result["command"],
+                "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
+                "stdout": result["stdout"],
+                "stderr": result["stderr"],
+                "package_id": package_id,
+                "available": result["exit_code"] == 0 and package_id is not None,
+            }
+            queries.append(query)
+            if selected is None and query["available"]:
+                selected = query
+        rows[candidate] = {
+            "package_queries": queries,
+            "available": selected is not None,
+            "package_manager": selected["manager"] if selected else None,
+            "package_id": selected["package_id"] if selected else None,
+        }
+    return rows

+def _installed_winget_executable(package_id: str, executable_name: str) -> Path | None:
+    package_root = Path(LOCAL_APPDATA) / "Microsoft" / "WinGet" / "Packages"

+def _install_command(manager: str, executable: str, package_id: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":

+def _local_package_managers() -> dict:
+    """PATH 탐색과 실행 가능한 승인 별칭 경로를 분리해 반환한다."""
+    managers = {}
+    for name in ("winget", "choco", "scoop"):
+        path_lookup = _run(["where.exe", name])
+        executable = None
+        discovery = "none"
+        probe = None
+        if path_lookup["exit_code"] == 0 and path_lookup["stdout"]:
+            executable = path_lookup["stdout"].splitlines()[0]
+            discovery = "PATH"
+        elif name == "winget" and WINGET_FALLBACK.is_file():
+            fallback_probe = _run([str(WINGET_FALLBACK), "--version"])
+            if fallback_probe["exit_code"] == 0:
+                executable = str(WINGET_FALLBACK)
+                discovery = "windowsapps_alias"
+                probe = fallback_probe
+        if executable and probe is None:
+            probe_args = [executable, "--version"] if name != "choco" else [executable, "--version"]
+            probe = _run(probe_args)
+        available = bool(executable and probe and probe["exit_code"] == 0)
+        managers[name] = {
+            "name": name,
+            "path_lookup": path_lookup,
+            "discovery": discovery if available else "none",
+            "executable": _redact(executable) if available else "없음",
+            "probe": probe,
+            "available": available,
+        }
+    return managers
+
+
+def _package_id(manager: str, stdout: str, candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    """패키지 관리자의 기계 판독 가능한 출력에서 패키지 ID를 읽는다."""
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return matches[0] if matches else None
+    if manager == "choco":
+        for line in stdout.splitlines():
+            package_id = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip()
+            if package_id.lower() == candidate.lower():
+                return package_id
+        return None
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        token = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if token.lower() == candidate.lower():
+            return token
+    return None
 
 
+def _query_command(manager: str, executable: str, candidate: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [
+            executable,
+            "search",
+            "--query",
+            candidate,
+            "--source",
+            "winget",
+            "--accept-source-agreements",
+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", candidate, "--exact", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", candidate]
+
+
+def _invocation_executable(display_executable: str) -> str:
+    if LOCAL_APPDATA:
+        return display_executable.replace("%LOCALAPPDATA%", LOCAL_APPDATA)
+    return display_executable
+

+def _query_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict) -> dict:
+    """기존 로컬 패키지 관리자에서 SAT 후보별 회답을 반환한다."""
+    rows = {}
+    for candidate in SAT_CANDIDATES:
+        queries = []
+        selected = None
+        for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+            if not manager_row["available"]:
+                continue
+            executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+            args = _query_command(manager, executable, candidate)
+            result = _run(args)
+            package_id = _package_id(manager, result["stdout"], candidate)
+            query = {
+                "manager": manager,
+                "command": result["command"],
+                "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
+                "stdout": result["stdout"],
+                "stderr": result["stderr"],
+                "package_id": package_id,
+                "available": result["exit_code"] == 0 and package_id is not None,
+            }
+            queries.append(query)
+            if selected is None and query["available"]:
+                selected = query
+        rows[candidate] = {
+            "package_queries": queries,
+            "available": selected is not None,
+            "package_manager": selected["manager"] if selected else None,
+            "package_id": selected["package_id"] if selected else None,
+        }
+    return rows
+

+def _installed_winget_executable(package_id: str, executable_name: str) -> Path | None:
+    package_root = Path(LOCAL_APPDATA) / "Microsoft" / "WinGet" / "Packages"
+    if not package_root.is_dir():
+        return None
+    matches = sorted(package_root.glob(f"{package_id}_*\\{executable_name}.exe"))
+    return matches[0] if matches else None

+def _measure_sat_candidate(name: str) -> dict:
+    executable_name, fallback, version_args = SAT_EXECUTABLES[name]
+    if name == "minisat":
+        fallback = _installed_winget_executable("PolarGoose.minisat", "minisat")
+    executable = _find_executable(executable_name, fallback)
+    return _solver_row(name, executable, version_args, "dimacs")

+def _install_command(manager: str, executable: str, package_id: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [
+            executable,
+            "install",
+            "--id",
+            package_id,
+            "--exact",
+            "--source",
+            "winget",
+            "--accept-package-agreements",
+            "--accept-source-agreements",
+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "install", package_id, "--yes", "--no-progress"]
+    return [executable, "install", package_id]
+

+def install_available_sat_candidates(report: dict) -> list[dict]:
+    """확보 가능 후보 전건을 설치하고 후보별 재측정을 반환한다."""
+    events = []
+    managers = report["runtime"]["local_package_managers"]
+    for candidate, row in report["sat_solvers"].items():
+        if not row["available"]:
+            continue
+        manager = row["package_manager"]
+        package_id = row["package_id"]
+        executable = _invocation_executable(managers[manager]["executable"])
+        result = _run(_install_command(manager, executable, package_id))
+        remeasurement = _measure_sat_candidate(candidate)
+        events.append(
+            {
+                "event_id": f"I-SAT-{candidate.upper()}",
+                "evidence_type": "recorded_event",
+                "candidate": candidate,
+                "target": candidate,
+                "package_manager": manager,
+                "package_id": package_id,
+                "command": result["command"],
+                "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
+                "stdout": result["stdout"],
+                "stderr": result["stderr"],
+                "remeasurement": remeasurement,
+                "source_coordinates": [
+                    "experiments/pvsnp/smoke/evidence/environment-changes.json"
+                ],
+            }
+        )
+    return events

+                return {"command": "winget.exe --version", "exit_code": 0, "stdout": "v1", "stderr": ""}
+            return {"command": " ".join(command), "exit_code": 1, "stdout": "", "stderr": "not found"}
+
+        fallback = mock.Mock()

+def _query_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict) -> dict:
+    """기존 로컬 패키지 관리자에서 SAT 후보별 회답을 반환한다."""

+                "package_id": package_id,
+                "available": result["exit_code"] == 0 and package_id is not None,
+            }
+            queries.append(query)

+def _package_id(manager: str, stdout: str, candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    """패키지 관리자의 기계 판독 가능한 출력에서 패키지 ID를 읽는다."""
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return matches[0] if matches else None
+    if manager == "choco":
+        for line in stdout.splitlines():
+            package_id = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip()
+            if package_id.lower() == candidate.lower():
+                return package_id
+        return None
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        token = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if token.lower() == candidate.lower():
+            return token
+    return None

+        def fake_run(args, **_kwargs):
+            command = [str(value) for value in args]
+            if command[:2] == ["where.exe", "winget"]:

+                return {"command": "winget.exe --version", "exit_code": 0, "stdout": "v1", "stderr": ""}

+        fallback = mock.Mock()

+            toolchain_smoke, "WINGET_FALLBACK", fallback

+def _local_package_managers() -> dict:
+    """PATH 탐색과 실행 가능한 승인 별칭 경로를 분리해 반환한다."""
+    managers = {}
+    for name in ("winget", "choco", "scoop"):
+        path_lookup = _run(["where.exe", name])
+        executable = None
+        discovery = "none"
+        probe = None
+        if path_lookup["exit_code"] == 0 and path_lookup["stdout"]:
+            executable = path_lookup["stdout"].splitlines()[0]
+            discovery = "PATH"
+        elif name == "winget" and WINGET_FALLBACK.is_file():
+            fallback_probe = _run([str(WINGET_FALLBACK), "--version"])
+            if fallback_probe["exit_code"] == 0:
+                executable = str(WINGET_FALLBACK)
+                discovery = "windowsapps_alias"
+                probe = fallback_probe
+        if executable and probe is None:
+            probe_args = [executable, "--version"] if name != "choco" else [executable, "--version"]
+            probe = _run(probe_args)
+        available = bool(executable and probe and probe["exit_code"] == 0)
+        managers[name] = {
+            "name": name,
+            "path_lookup": path_lookup,
+            "discovery": discovery if available else "none",
+            "executable": _redact(executable) if available else "없음",
+            "probe": probe,
+            "available": available,
+        }
+    return managers

+def _package_id(manager: str, stdout: str, candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    """패키지 관리자의 기계 판독 가능한 출력에서 패키지 ID를 읽는다."""
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return matches[0] if matches else None
+    if manager == "choco":
+        for line in stdout.splitlines():
+            package_id = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip()
+            if package_id.lower() == candidate.lower():
+                return package_id
+        return None
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        token = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if token.lower() == candidate.lower():
+            return token
+    return None
+

+def _query_command(manager: str, executable: str, candidate: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [
+            executable,
+            "search",
+            "--query",
+            candidate,
+            "--source",
+            "winget",
+            "--accept-source-agreements",
+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", candidate, "--exact", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", candidate]

+def _invocation_executable(display_executable: str) -> str:
+    if LOCAL_APPDATA:
+        return display_executable.replace("%LOCALAPPDATA%", LOCAL_APPDATA)
+    return display_executable

+def _query_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict) -> dict:
+    """기존 로컬 패키지 관리자에서 SAT 후보별 회답을 반환한다."""
+    rows = {}
+    for candidate in SAT_CANDIDATES:
+        queries = []
+        selected = None
+        for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+            if not manager_row["available"]:
+                continue
+            executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+            args = _query_command(manager, executable, candidate)
+            result = _run(args)
+            package_id = _package_id(manager, result["stdout"], candidate)
+            query = {
+                "manager": manager,
+                "command": result["command"],
+                "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
+                "stdout": result["stdout"],
+                "stderr": result["stderr"],
+                "package_id": package_id,
+                "available": result["exit_code"] == 0 and package_id is not None,
+            }
+            queries.append(query)
+            if selected is None and query["available"]:
+                selected = query
+        rows[candidate] = {
+            "package_queries": queries,
+            "available": selected is not None,
+            "package_manager": selected["manager"] if selected else None,
+            "package_id": selected["package_id"] if selected else None,
+        }
+    return rows

+def _local_package_managers() -> dict:
+    """PATH 탐색과 실행 가능한 승인 별칭 경로를 분리해 반환한다."""
+    managers = {}
+    for name in ("winget", "choco", "scoop"):
+        path_lookup = _run(["where.exe", name])
+        executable = None
+        discovery = "none"
+        probe = None
+        if path_lookup["exit_code"] == 0 and path_lookup["stdout"]:
+            executable = path_lookup["stdout"].splitlines()[0]
+            discovery = "PATH"
+        elif name == "winget" and WINGET_FALLBACK.is_file():
+            fallback_probe = _run([str(WINGET_FALLBACK), "--version"])
+            if fallback_probe["exit_code"] == 0:
+                executable = str(WINGET_FALLBACK)
+                discovery = "windowsapps_alias"
+                probe = fallback_probe
+        if executable and probe is None:
+            probe_args = [executable, "--version"] if name != "choco" else [executable, "--version"]
+            probe = _run(probe_args)
+        available = bool(executable and probe and probe["exit_code"] == 0)
+        managers[name] = {
+            "name": name,
+            "path_lookup": path_lookup,
+            "discovery": discovery if available else "none",
+            "executable": _redact(executable) if available else "없음",
+            "probe": probe,
+            "available": available,
+        }
+    return managers

+def _package_id(manager: str, stdout: str, candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    """패키지 관리자의 기계 판독 가능한 출력에서 패키지 ID를 읽는다."""
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return matches[0] if matches else None
+    if manager == "choco":
+        for line in stdout.splitlines():
+            package_id = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip()
+            if package_id.lower() == candidate.lower():
+                return package_id
+        return None
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        token = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if token.lower() == candidate.lower():
+            return token
+    return None

+def _query_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict) -> dict:
+    """기존 로컬 패키지 관리자에서 SAT 후보별 회답을 반환한다."""
+    rows = {}

+            args = _query_command(manager, executable, candidate)

+            query = {
+                "manager": manager,
+                "command": result["command"],
+                "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
+                "stdout": result["stdout"],
+                "stderr": result["stderr"],
+                "package_id": package_id,
+                "available": result["exit_code"] == 0 and package_id is not None,
+            }
+            queries.append(query)
+            if selected is None and query["available"]:
+                selected = query
+        rows[candidate] = {
+            "package_queries": queries,
+            "available": selected is not None,
+            "package_manager": selected["manager"] if selected else None,
+            "package_id": selected["package_id"] if selected else None,
+        }
+    return rows

+def _local_package_managers() -> dict:
+    """PATH 탐색과 실행 가능한 승인 별칭 경로를 분리해 반환한다."""
+    managers = {}
+    for name in ("winget", "choco", "scoop"):
+        path_lookup = _run(["where.exe", name])
+        executable = None
+        discovery = "none"
+        probe = None
+        if path_lookup["exit_code"] == 0 and path_lookup["stdout"]:
+            executable = path_lookup["stdout"].splitlines()[0]
+            discovery = "PATH"
+        elif name == "winget" and WINGET_FALLBACK.is_file():
+            fallback_probe = _run([str(WINGET_FALLBACK), "--version"])
+            if fallback_probe["exit_code"] == 0:
+                executable = str(WINGET_FALLBACK)
+                discovery = "windowsapps_alias"
+                probe = fallback_probe
+        if executable and probe is None:
+            probe_args = [executable, "--version"] if name != "choco" else [executable, "--version"]
+            probe = _run(probe_args)
+        available = bool(executable and probe and probe["exit_code"] == 0)
+        managers[name] = {
+            "name": name,
+            "path_lookup": path_lookup,
+            "discovery": discovery if available else "none",
+            "executable": _redact(executable) if available else "없음",
+            "probe": probe,
+            "available": available,
+        }
+    return managers
+
+
+def _package_id(manager: str, stdout: str, candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    """패키지 관리자의 기계 판독 가능한 출력에서 패키지 ID를 읽는다."""
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return matches[0] if matches else None
+    if manager == "choco":
+        for line in stdout.splitlines():
+            package_id = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip()
+            if package_id.lower() == candidate.lower():
+                return package_id
+        return None
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        token = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if token.lower() == candidate.lower():
+            return token
+    return None
+
+
+def _query_command(manager: str, executable: str, candidate: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [
+            executable,
+            "search",
+            "--query",
+            candidate,
+            "--source",
+            "winget",
+            "--accept-source-agreements",
+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", candidate, "--exact", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", candidate]

+def _invocation_executable(display_executable: str) -> str:
+    if LOCAL_APPDATA:
+        return display_executable.replace("%LOCALAPPDATA%", LOCAL_APPDATA)
+    return display_executable

+def _query_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict) -> dict:
+    """기존 로컬 패키지 관리자에서 SAT 후보별 회답을 반환한다."""
+    rows = {}
+    for candidate in SAT_CANDIDATES:
+        queries = []
+        selected = None
+        for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+            if not manager_row["available"]:
+                continue
+            executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+            args = _query_command(manager, executable, candidate)
+            result = _run(args)
+            package_id = _package_id(manager, result["stdout"], candidate)
+            query = {
+                "manager": manager,
+                "command": result["command"],
+                "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
+                "stdout": result["stdout"],
+                "stderr": result["stderr"],
+                "package_id": package_id,
+                "available": result["exit_code"] == 0 and package_id is not None,
+            }
+            queries.append(query)
+            if selected is None and query["available"]:
+                selected = query
+        rows[candidate] = {
+            "package_queries": queries,
+            "available": selected is not None,
+            "package_manager": selected["manager"] if selected else None,
+            "package_id": selected["package_id"] if selected else None,
+        }
+    return rows

+def _installed_winget_executable(package_id: str, executable_name: str) -> Path | None:

+    def test_path_invisible_winget_uses_only_executable_windowsapps_alias(self):
+        def fake_run(args, **_kwargs):
+            command = [str(value) for value in args]
+            if command[:2] == ["where.exe", "winget"]:
+                return {"command": "where.exe winget", "exit_code": 1, "stdout": "", "stderr": "not found"}
+            if command[-1] == "--version":
+                return {"command": "winget.exe --version", "exit_code": 0, "stdout": "v1", "stderr": ""}
+            return {"command": " ".join(command), "exit_code": 1, "stdout": "", "stderr": "not found"}
+
+        fallback = mock.Mock()
+        fallback.is_file.return_value = True
+        fallback.__str__ = mock.Mock(return_value="C:\\WindowsApps\\winget.exe")
+        with mock.patch.object(toolchain_smoke, "_run", side_effect=fake_run), mock.patch.object(
+            toolchain_smoke, "WINGET_FALLBACK", fallback

+        winget = managers["winget"]

+def _local_package_managers() -> dict:
+    """PATH 탐색과 실행 가능한 승인 별칭 경로를 분리해 반환한다."""
+    managers = {}
+    for name in ("winget", "choco", "scoop"):
+        path_lookup = _run(["where.exe", name])
+        executable = None
+        discovery = "none"
+        probe = None
+        if path_lookup["exit_code"] == 0 and path_lookup["stdout"]:
+            executable = path_lookup["stdout"].splitlines()[0]
+            discovery = "PATH"
+        elif name == "winget" and WINGET_FALLBACK.is_file():
+            fallback_probe = _run([str(WINGET_FALLBACK), "--version"])
+            if fallback_probe["exit_code"] == 0:
+                executable = str(WINGET_FALLBACK)
+                discovery = "windowsapps_alias"
+                probe = fallback_probe
+        if executable and probe is None:
+            probe_args = [executable, "--version"] if name != "choco" else [executable, "--version"]
+            probe = _run(probe_args)
+        available = bool(executable and probe and probe["exit_code"] == 0)
+        managers[name] = {
+            "name": name,
+            "path_lookup": path_lookup,
+            "discovery": discovery if available else "none",
+            "executable": _redact(executable) if available else "없음",
+            "probe": probe,
+            "available": available,
+        }
+    return managers
+

+def _package_id(manager: str, stdout: str, candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    """패키지 관리자의 기계 판독 가능한 출력에서 패키지 ID를 읽는다."""
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return matches[0] if matches else None
+    if manager == "choco":
+        for line in stdout.splitlines():
+            package_id = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip()
+            if package_id.lower() == candidate.lower():
+                return package_id
+        return None
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        token = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if token.lower() == candidate.lower():
+            return token
+    return None
+
+
+def _query_command(manager: str, executable: str, candidate: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [
+            executable,
+            "search",
+            "--query",
+            candidate,
+            "--source",
+            "winget",
+            "--accept-source-agreements",
+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", candidate, "--exact", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", candidate]

+def _invocation_executable(display_executable: str) -> str:
+    if LOCAL_APPDATA:
+        return display_executable.replace("%LOCALAPPDATA%", LOCAL_APPDATA)
+    return display_executable

+def _query_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict) -> dict:
+    """기존 로컬 패키지 관리자에서 SAT 후보별 회답을 반환한다."""
+    rows = {}
+    for candidate in SAT_CANDIDATES:
+        queries = []
+        selected = None
+        for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+            if not manager_row["available"]:
+                continue
+            executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+            args = _query_command(manager, executable, candidate)
+            result = _run(args)
+            package_id = _package_id(manager, result["stdout"], candidate)
+            query = {
+                "manager": manager,
+                "command": result["command"],
+                "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
+                "stdout": result["stdout"],
+                "stderr": result["stderr"],
+                "package_id": package_id,
+                "available": result["exit_code"] == 0 and package_id is not None,
+            }
+            queries.append(query)
+            if selected is None and query["available"]:
+                selected = query
+        rows[candidate] = {
+            "package_queries": queries,
+            "available": selected is not None,
+            "package_manager": selected["manager"] if selected else None,
+            "package_id": selected["package_id"] if selected else None,
+        }
+    return rows

+    def test_path_invisible_winget_uses_only_executable_windowsapps_alias(self):
+        def fake_run(args, **_kwargs):
+            command = [str(value) for value in args]
+            if command[:2] == ["where.exe", "winget"]:
+                return {"command": "where.exe winget", "exit_code": 1, "stdout": "", "stderr": "not found"}
+            if command[-1] == "--version":
+                return {"command": "winget.exe --version", "exit_code": 0, "stdout": "v1", "stderr": ""}
+            return {"command": " ".join(command), "exit_code": 1, "stdout": "", "stderr": "not found"}
+
+        fallback = mock.Mock()
+        fallback.is_file.return_value = True
+        fallback.__str__ = mock.Mock(return_value="C:\\WindowsApps\\winget.exe")
+        with mock.patch.object(toolchain_smoke, "_run", side_effect=fake_run), mock.patch.object(
+            toolchain_smoke, "WINGET_FALLBACK", fallback
+        ):
+            managers = toolchain_smoke._local_package_managers()
+        winget = managers["winget"]

+        self.assertTrue(winget["available"])

+        self.assertEqual(0, winget["probe"]["exit_code"])

+def _local_package_managers() -> dict:
+    """PATH 탐색과 실행 가능한 승인 별칭 경로를 분리해 반환한다."""
+    managers = {}
+    for name in ("winget", "choco", "scoop"):
+        path_lookup = _run(["where.exe", name])
+        executable = None
+        discovery = "none"
+        probe = None
+        if path_lookup["exit_code"] == 0 and path_lookup["stdout"]:
+            executable = path_lookup["stdout"].splitlines()[0]
+            discovery = "PATH"
+        elif name == "winget" and WINGET_FALLBACK.is_file():
+            fallback_probe = _run([str(WINGET_FALLBACK), "--version"])
+            if fallback_probe["exit_code"] == 0:
+                executable = str(WINGET_FALLBACK)
+                discovery = "windowsapps_alias"
+                probe = fallback_probe
+        if executable and probe is None:
+            probe_args = [executable, "--version"] if name != "choco" else [executable, "--version"]
+            probe = _run(probe_args)
+        available = bool(executable and probe and probe["exit_code"] == 0)
+        managers[name] = {
+            "name": name,
+            "path_lookup": path_lookup,
+            "discovery": discovery if available else "none",
+            "executable": _redact(executable) if available else "없음",
+            "probe": probe,
+            "available": available,
+        }
+    return managers
+

+def _package_id(manager: str, stdout: str, candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    """패키지 관리자의 기계 판독 가능한 출력에서 패키지 ID를 읽는다."""
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return matches[0] if matches else None
+    if manager == "choco":
+        for line in stdout.splitlines():
+            package_id = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip()
+            if package_id.lower() == candidate.lower():
+                return package_id
+        return None
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        token = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if token.lower() == candidate.lower():
+            return token
+    return None
+
+
+def _query_command(manager: str, executable: str, candidate: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [
+            executable,
+            "search",
+            "--query",
+            candidate,
+            "--source",
+            "winget",
+            "--accept-source-agreements",
+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", candidate, "--exact", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", candidate]

+def _invocation_executable(display_executable: str) -> str:
+    if LOCAL_APPDATA:
+        return display_executable.replace("%LOCALAPPDATA%", LOCAL_APPDATA)
+    return display_executable

+def _query_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict) -> dict:
+    """기존 로컬 패키지 관리자에서 SAT 후보별 회답을 반환한다."""
+    rows = {}
+    for candidate in SAT_CANDIDATES:
+        queries = []
+        selected = None
+        for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+            if not manager_row["available"]:
+                continue
+            executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+            args = _query_command(manager, executable, candidate)
+            result = _run(args)
+            package_id = _package_id(manager, result["stdout"], candidate)
+            query = {
+                "manager": manager,
+                "command": result["command"],
+                "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
+                "stdout": result["stdout"],
+                "stderr": result["stderr"],
+                "package_id": package_id,
+                "available": result["exit_code"] == 0 and package_id is not None,
+            }
+            queries.append(query)
+            if selected is None and query["available"]:
+                selected = query
+        rows[candidate] = {
+            "package_queries": queries,
+            "available": selected is not None,
+            "package_manager": selected["manager"] if selected else None,
+            "package_id": selected["package_id"] if selected else None,
+        }
+    return rows

+def _local_package_managers() -> dict:
+    """PATH 탐색과 실행 가능한 승인 별칭 경로를 분리해 반환한다."""
+    managers = {}
+    for name in ("winget", "choco", "scoop"):
+        path_lookup = _run(["where.exe", name])
+        executable = None
+        discovery = "none"
+        probe = None
+        if path_lookup["exit_code"] == 0 and path_lookup["stdout"]:
+            executable = path_lookup["stdout"].splitlines()[0]
+            discovery = "PATH"
+        elif name == "winget" and WINGET_FALLBACK.is_file():
+            fallback_probe = _run([str(WINGET_FALLBACK), "--version"])
+            if fallback_probe["exit_code"] == 0:
+                executable = str(WINGET_FALLBACK)
+                discovery = "windowsapps_alias"
+                probe = fallback_probe
+        if executable and probe is None:
+            probe_args = [executable, "--version"] if name != "choco" else [executable, "--version"]
+            probe = _run(probe_args)
+        available = bool(executable and probe and probe["exit_code"] == 0)
+        managers[name] = {
+            "name": name,
+            "path_lookup": path_lookup,
+            "discovery": discovery if available else "none",
+            "executable": _redact(executable) if available else "없음",
+            "probe": probe,
+            "available": available,
+        }
+    return managers
+
+
+def _package_id(manager: str, stdout: str, candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    """패키지 관리자의 기계 판독 가능한 출력에서 패키지 ID를 읽는다."""
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return matches[0] if matches else None
+    if manager == "choco":
+        for line in stdout.splitlines():
+            package_id = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip()
+            if package_id.lower() == candidate.lower():
+                return package_id
+        return None
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        token = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if token.lower() == candidate.lower():
+            return token
+    return None
+
+
+def _query_command(manager: str, executable: str, candidate: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [
+            executable,
+            "search",
+            "--query",
+            candidate,
+            "--source",
+            "winget",
+            "--accept-source-agreements",
+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", candidate, "--exact", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", candidate]

+def _invocation_executable(display_executable: str) -> str:
+    if LOCAL_APPDATA:
+        return display_executable.replace("%LOCALAPPDATA%", LOCAL_APPDATA)
+    return display_executable

+def _query_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict) -> dict:
+    """기존 로컬 패키지 관리자에서 SAT 후보별 회답을 반환한다."""
+    rows = {}
+    for candidate in SAT_CANDIDATES:
+        queries = []
+        selected = None
+        for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+            if not manager_row["available"]:
+                continue
+            executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+            args = _query_command(manager, executable, candidate)
+            result = _run(args)
+            package_id = _package_id(manager, result["stdout"], candidate)
+            query = {
+                "manager": manager,
+                "command": result["command"],
+                "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
+                "stdout": result["stdout"],
+                "stderr": result["stderr"],
+                "package_id": package_id,
+                "available": result["exit_code"] == 0 and package_id is not None,
+            }
+            queries.append(query)
+            if selected is None and query["available"]:
+                selected = query
+        rows[candidate] = {
+            "package_queries": queries,
+            "available": selected is not None,
+            "package_manager": selected["manager"] if selected else None,
+            "package_id": selected["package_id"] if selected else None,
+        }
+    return rows

+def _installed_winget_executable(package_id: str, executable_name: str) -> Path | None:
+    package_root = Path(LOCAL_APPDATA) / "Microsoft" / "WinGet" / "Packages"
+    if not package_root.is_dir():
+        return None
+    matches = sorted(package_root.glob(f"{package_id}_*\\{executable_name}.exe"))
+    return matches[0] if matches else None

+def _measure_sat_candidate(name: str) -> dict:
+    executable_name, fallback, version_args = SAT_EXECUTABLES[name]
+    if name == "minisat":

+    executable = _find_executable(executable_name, fallback)

+def _install_command(manager: str, executable: str, package_id: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [
+            executable,
+            "install",

+            "--accept-source-agreements",
+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "install", package_id, "--yes", "--no-progress"]
+    return [executable, "install", package_id]

+def install_available_sat_candidates(report: dict) -> list[dict]:
+    """확보 가능 후보 전건을 설치하고 후보별 재측정을 반환한다."""

+                    "experiments/pvsnp/smoke/evidence/environment-changes.json"
+                ],
+            }
+        )
+    return events

 Z3_FALLBACK = TOOL_ROOT / "z3-5.1.0" / "z3-5.1.0-x64-win" / "bin" / "z3.exe"

+def _local_package_managers() -> dict:
+    """PATH 탐색과 실행 가능한 승인 별칭 경로를 분리해 반환한다."""
+    managers = {}
+    for name in ("winget", "choco", "scoop"):
+        path_lookup = _run(["where.exe", name])
+        executable = None
+        discovery = "none"
+        probe = None
+        if path_lookup["exit_code"] == 0 and path_lookup["stdout"]:
+            executable = path_lookup["stdout"].splitlines()[0]
+            discovery = "PATH"
+        elif name == "winget" and WINGET_FALLBACK.is_file():
+            fallback_probe = _run([str(WINGET_FALLBACK), "--version"])
+            if fallback_probe["exit_code"] == 0:
+                executable = str(WINGET_FALLBACK)
+                discovery = "windowsapps_alias"
+                probe = fallback_probe
+        if executable and probe is None:
+            probe_args = [executable, "--version"] if name != "choco" else [executable, "--version"]
+            probe = _run(probe_args)
+        available = bool(executable and probe and probe["exit_code"] == 0)
+        managers[name] = {
+            "name": name,
+            "path_lookup": path_lookup,
+            "discovery": discovery if available else "none",
+            "executable": _redact(executable) if available else "없음",
+            "probe": probe,
+            "available": available,
+        }
+    return managers
+
+
+def _package_id(manager: str, stdout: str, candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    """패키지 관리자의 기계 판독 가능한 출력에서 패키지 ID를 읽는다."""
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return matches[0] if matches else None
+    if manager == "choco":
+        for line in stdout.splitlines():
+            package_id = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip()
+            if package_id.lower() == candidate.lower():
+                return package_id
+        return None
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        token = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if token.lower() == candidate.lower():
+            return token
+    return None
+
+
+def _query_command(manager: str, executable: str, candidate: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [
+            executable,
+            "search",
+            "--query",
+            candidate,
+            "--source",
+            "winget",
+            "--accept-source-agreements",
+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", candidate, "--exact", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", candidate]
+
+
+def _invocation_executable(display_executable: str) -> str:
+    if LOCAL_APPDATA:
+        return display_executable.replace("%LOCALAPPDATA%", LOCAL_APPDATA)
+    return display_executable
+
+
+def _query_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict) -> dict:
+    """기존 로컬 패키지 관리자에서 SAT 후보별 회답을 반환한다."""
+    rows = {}
+    for candidate in SAT_CANDIDATES:
+        queries = []
+        selected = None
+        for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+            if not manager_row["available"]:
+                continue
+            executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+            args = _query_command(manager, executable, candidate)
+            result = _run(args)
+            package_id = _package_id(manager, result["stdout"], candidate)
+            query = {
+                "manager": manager,

+            }

+            "package_id": selected["package_id"] if selected else None,
+        }
+    return rows

+def _installed_winget_executable(package_id: str, executable_name: str) -> Path | None:
+    package_root = Path(LOCAL_APPDATA) / "Microsoft" / "WinGet" / "Packages"
+    if not package_root.is_dir():
+        return None
+    matches = sorted(package_root.glob(f"{package_id}_*\\{executable_name}.exe"))
+    return matches[0] if matches else None

+def _measure_sat_candidate(name: str) -> dict:
+    executable_name, fallback, version_args = SAT_EXECUTABLES[name]
+    if name == "minisat":
+        fallback = _installed_winget_executable("PolarGoose.minisat", "minisat")
+    executable = _find_executable(executable_name, fallback)
+    return _solver_row(name, executable, version_args, "dimacs")

+def _install_command(manager: str, executable: str, package_id: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [
+            executable,
+            "install",
+            "--id",
+            package_id,
+            "--exact",

+            "winget",

+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":

+    return [executable, "install", package_id]

+def install_available_sat_candidates(report: dict) -> list[dict]:
+    """확보 가능 후보 전건을 설치하고 후보별 재측정을 반환한다."""
+    events = []

+        package_id = row["package_id"]

+        result = _run(_install_command(manager, executable, package_id))
+        remeasurement = _measure_sat_candidate(candidate)

+                "source_coordinates": [
+                    "experiments/pvsnp/smoke/evidence/environment-changes.json"
+                ],
+            }
+        )
+    return events

+def _local_package_managers() -> dict:
+    """PATH 탐색과 실행 가능한 승인 별칭 경로를 분리해 반환한다."""
+    managers = {}
+    for name in ("winget", "choco", "scoop"):
+        path_lookup = _run(["where.exe", name])
+        executable = None
+        discovery = "none"
+        probe = None
+        if path_lookup["exit_code"] == 0 and path_lookup["stdout"]:
+            executable = path_lookup["stdout"].splitlines()[0]
+            discovery = "PATH"
+        elif name == "winget" and WINGET_FALLBACK.is_file():
+            fallback_probe = _run([str(WINGET_FALLBACK), "--version"])
+            if fallback_probe["exit_code"] == 0:
+                executable = str(WINGET_FALLBACK)
+                discovery = "windowsapps_alias"
+                probe = fallback_probe
+        if executable and probe is None:
+            probe_args = [executable, "--version"] if name != "choco" else [executable, "--version"]
+            probe = _run(probe_args)
+        available = bool(executable and probe and probe["exit_code"] == 0)
+        managers[name] = {
+            "name": name,
+            "path_lookup": path_lookup,
+            "discovery": discovery if available else "none",
+            "executable": _redact(executable) if available else "없음",
+            "probe": probe,
+            "available": available,
+        }
+    return managers

+def _package_id(manager: str, stdout: str, candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    """패키지 관리자의 기계 판독 가능한 출력에서 패키지 ID를 읽는다."""
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return matches[0] if matches else None
+    if manager == "choco":
+        for line in stdout.splitlines():
+            package_id = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip()
+            if package_id.lower() == candidate.lower():
+                return package_id
+        return None
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        token = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if token.lower() == candidate.lower():
+            return token
+    return None
+
+
+def _query_command(manager: str, executable: str, candidate: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [
+            executable,
+            "search",
+            "--query",
+            candidate,
+            "--source",
+            "winget",
+            "--accept-source-agreements",
+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", candidate, "--exact", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", candidate]

+def _invocation_executable(display_executable: str) -> str:
+    if LOCAL_APPDATA:
+        return display_executable.replace("%LOCALAPPDATA%", LOCAL_APPDATA)
+    return display_executable

+def _query_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict) -> dict:
+    """기존 로컬 패키지 관리자에서 SAT 후보별 회답을 반환한다."""
+    rows = {}
+    for candidate in SAT_CANDIDATES:
+        queries = []
+        selected = None
+        for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+            if not manager_row["available"]:
+                continue
+            executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+            args = _query_command(manager, executable, candidate)
+            result = _run(args)
+            package_id = _package_id(manager, result["stdout"], candidate)
+            query = {
+                "manager": manager,
+                "command": result["command"],
+                "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
+                "stdout": result["stdout"],
+                "stderr": result["stderr"],
+                "package_id": package_id,
+                "available": result["exit_code"] == 0 and package_id is not None,
+            }
+            queries.append(query)
+            if selected is None and query["available"]:
+                selected = query
+        rows[candidate] = {
+            "package_queries": queries,
+            "available": selected is not None,
+            "package_manager": selected["manager"] if selected else None,
+            "package_id": selected["package_id"] if selected else None,
+        }
+    return rows

 class ToolchainSmokeTest(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_path_invisible_winget_uses_only_executable_windowsapps_alias(self):
+        def fake_run(args, **_kwargs):
+            command = [str(value) for value in args]
+            if command[:2] == ["where.exe", "winget"]:
+                return {"command": "where.exe winget", "exit_code": 1, "stdout": "", "stderr": "not found"}
+            if command[-1] == "--version":
+                return {"command": "winget.exe --version", "exit_code": 0, "stdout": "v1", "stderr": ""}
+            return {"command": " ".join(command), "exit_code": 1, "stdout": "", "stderr": "not found"}
+
+        fallback = mock.Mock()
+        fallback.is_file.return_value = True
+        fallback.__str__ = mock.Mock(return_value="C:\\WindowsApps\\winget.exe")
+        with mock.patch.object(toolchain_smoke, "_run", side_effect=fake_run), mock.patch.object(
+            toolchain_smoke, "WINGET_FALLBACK", fallback
+        ):
+            managers = toolchain_smoke._local_package_managers()
+        winget = managers["winget"]
+        self.assertEqual("windowsapps_alias", winget["discovery"])
+        self.assertTrue(winget["available"])
+        self.assertEqual(1, winget["path_lookup"]["exit_code"])
+        self.assertEqual(0, winget["probe"]["exit_code"])

+    def test_candidate_queries_have_complete_structure_and_derive_availability(self):

+        }
+
+        def fake_run(args, **_kwargs):
+            candidate = str(args[3])
+            stdout = responses[candidate]
+            return {

+                "exit_code": 0 if candidate == "minisat" else 1,
+                "stdout": stdout,
+                "stderr": "",
+            }
+
+        with mock.patch.object(toolchain_smoke, "_run", side_effect=fake_run):
+            rows = toolchain_smoke._query_sat_candidates(managers)
+        self.assertEqual(set(toolchain_smoke.SAT_CANDIDATES), set(rows))
+        required = {"manager", "command", "exit_code", "stdout", "stderr", "package_id", "available"}

+            self.assertTrue(event["package_id"])
+            self.assertIn("remeasurement", event)

+def _local_package_managers() -> dict:
+    """PATH 탐색과 실행 가능한 승인 별칭 경로를 분리해 반환한다."""
+    managers = {}
+    for name in ("winget", "choco", "scoop"):
+        path_lookup = _run(["where.exe", name])
+        executable = None
+        discovery = "none"
+        probe = None
+        if path_lookup["exit_code"] == 0 and path_lookup["stdout"]:
+            executable = path_lookup["stdout"].splitlines()[0]
+            discovery = "PATH"
+        elif name == "winget" and WINGET_FALLBACK.is_file():
+            fallback_probe = _run([str(WINGET_FALLBACK), "--version"])
+            if fallback_probe["exit_code"] == 0:
+                executable = str(WINGET_FALLBACK)
+                discovery = "windowsapps_alias"
+                probe = fallback_probe
+        if executable and probe is None:
+            probe_args = [executable, "--version"] if name != "choco" else [executable, "--version"]
+            probe = _run(probe_args)
+        available = bool(executable and probe and probe["exit_code"] == 0)
+        managers[name] = {
+            "name": name,
+            "path_lookup": path_lookup,
+            "discovery": discovery if available else "none",
+            "executable": _redact(executable) if available else "없음",
+            "probe": probe,
+            "available": available,
+        }
+    return managers
+
+
+def _package_id(manager: str, stdout: str, candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    """패키지 관리자의 기계 판독 가능한 출력에서 패키지 ID를 읽는다."""
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return matches[0] if matches else None
+    if manager == "choco":
+        for line in stdout.splitlines():
+            package_id = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip()
+            if package_id.lower() == candidate.lower():
+                return package_id
+        return None
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        token = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if token.lower() == candidate.lower():
+            return token
+    return None
+
+
+def _query_command(manager: str, executable: str, candidate: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [
+            executable,
+            "search",
+            "--query",
+            candidate,
+            "--source",
+            "winget",
+            "--accept-source-agreements",
+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", candidate, "--exact", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", candidate]
+
+
+def _invocation_executable(display_executable: str) -> str:
+    if LOCAL_APPDATA:
+        return display_executable.replace("%LOCALAPPDATA%", LOCAL_APPDATA)
+    return display_executable
+

+def _query_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict) -> dict:
+    """기존 로컬 패키지 관리자에서 SAT 후보별 회답을 반환한다."""
+    rows = {}
+    for candidate in SAT_CANDIDATES:
+        queries = []
+        selected = None
+        for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+            if not manager_row["available"]:
+                continue
+            executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+            args = _query_command(manager, executable, candidate)
+            result = _run(args)
+            package_id = _package_id(manager, result["stdout"], candidate)
+            query = {
+                "manager": manager,
+                "command": result["command"],
+                "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
+                "stdout": result["stdout"],
+                "stderr": result["stderr"],
+                "package_id": package_id,
+                "available": result["exit_code"] == 0 and package_id is not None,
+            }
+            queries.append(query)
+            if selected is None and query["available"]:
+                selected = query
+        rows[candidate] = {
+            "package_queries": queries,
+            "available": selected is not None,
+            "package_manager": selected["manager"] if selected else None,
+            "package_id": selected["package_id"] if selected else None,
+        }
+    return rows

+def _installed_winget_executable(package_id: str, executable_name: str) -> Path | None:
+    package_root = Path(LOCAL_APPDATA) / "Microsoft" / "WinGet" / "Packages"
+    if not package_root.is_dir():
+        return None

+def _measure_sat_candidate(name: str) -> dict:

+def _install_command(manager: str, executable: str, package_id: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":

+def install_available_sat_candidates(report: dict) -> list[dict]:

+                    "experiments/pvsnp/smoke/evidence/environment-changes.json"

+            }

+def _local_package_managers() -> dict:
+    """PATH 탐색과 실행 가능한 승인 별칭 경로를 분리해 반환한다."""
+    managers = {}
+    for name in ("winget", "choco", "scoop"):
+        path_lookup = _run(["where.exe", name])
+        executable = None
+        discovery = "none"
+        probe = None
+        if path_lookup["exit_code"] == 0 and path_lookup["stdout"]:
+            executable = path_lookup["stdout"].splitlines()[0]
+            discovery = "PATH"
+        elif name == "winget" and WINGET_FALLBACK.is_file():
+            fallback_probe = _run([str(WINGET_FALLBACK), "--version"])
+            if fallback_probe["exit_code"] == 0:
+                executable = str(WINGET_FALLBACK)
+                discovery = "windowsapps_alias"
+                probe = fallback_probe
+        if executable and probe is None:
+            probe_args = [executable, "--version"] if name != "choco" else [executable, "--version"]
+            probe = _run(probe_args)
+        available = bool(executable and probe and probe["exit_code"] == 0)
+        managers[name] = {
+            "name": name,
+            "path_lookup": path_lookup,
+            "discovery": discovery if available else "none",
+            "executable": _redact(executable) if available else "없음",
+            "probe": probe,
+            "available": available,
+        }
+    return managers

+def _package_id(manager: str, stdout: str, candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    """패키지 관리자의 기계 판독 가능한 출력에서 패키지 ID를 읽는다."""
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return matches[0] if matches else None
+    if manager == "choco":
+        for line in stdout.splitlines():
+            package_id = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip()
+            if package_id.lower() == candidate.lower():
+                return package_id
+        return None
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        token = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if token.lower() == candidate.lower():
+            return token
+    return None
+
+
+def _query_command(manager: str, executable: str, candidate: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [
+            executable,
+            "search",
+            "--query",
+            candidate,
+            "--source",
+            "winget",
+            "--accept-source-agreements",
+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", candidate, "--exact", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", candidate]

+def _invocation_executable(display_executable: str) -> str:
+    if LOCAL_APPDATA:
+        return display_executable.replace("%LOCALAPPDATA%", LOCAL_APPDATA)
+    return display_executable

+def _query_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict) -> dict:
+    """기존 로컬 패키지 관리자에서 SAT 후보별 회답을 반환한다."""
+    rows = {}
+    for candidate in SAT_CANDIDATES:
+        queries = []
+        selected = None
+        for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+            if not manager_row["available"]:
+                continue
+            executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+            args = _query_command(manager, executable, candidate)
+            result = _run(args)
+            package_id = _package_id(manager, result["stdout"], candidate)
+            query = {
+                "manager": manager,
+                "command": result["command"],
+                "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
+                "stdout": result["stdout"],
+                "stderr": result["stderr"],
+                "package_id": package_id,
+                "available": result["exit_code"] == 0 and package_id is not None,
+            }
+            queries.append(query)
+            if selected is None and query["available"]:
+                selected = query
+        rows[candidate] = {
+            "package_queries": queries,
+            "available": selected is not None,
+            "package_manager": selected["manager"] if selected else None,
+            "package_id": selected["package_id"] if selected else None,
+        }
+    return rows

+def _installed_winget_executable(package_id: str, executable_name: str) -> Path | None:

+def _local_package_managers() -> dict:
+    """PATH 탐색과 실행 가능한 승인 별칭 경로를 분리해 반환한다."""
+    managers = {}
+    for name in ("winget", "choco", "scoop"):
+        path_lookup = _run(["where.exe", name])
+        executable = None
+        discovery = "none"
+        probe = None
+        if path_lookup["exit_code"] == 0 and path_lookup["stdout"]:
+            executable = path_lookup["stdout"].splitlines()[0]
+            discovery = "PATH"
+        elif name == "winget" and WINGET_FALLBACK.is_file():
+            fallback_probe = _run([str(WINGET_FALLBACK), "--version"])
+            if fallback_probe["exit_code"] == 0:
+                executable = str(WINGET_FALLBACK)
+                discovery = "windowsapps_alias"
+                probe = fallback_probe
+        if executable and probe is None:
+            probe_args = [executable, "--version"] if name != "choco" else [executable, "--version"]
+            probe = _run(probe_args)
+        available = bool(executable and probe and probe["exit_code"] == 0)
+        managers[name] = {
+            "name": name,
+            "path_lookup": path_lookup,
+            "discovery": discovery if available else "none",
+            "executable": _redact(executable) if available else "없음",
+            "probe": probe,
+            "available": available,
+        }
+    return managers
+

+def _package_id(manager: str, stdout: str, candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    """패키지 관리자의 기계 판독 가능한 출력에서 패키지 ID를 읽는다."""
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return matches[0] if matches else None
+    if manager == "choco":
+        for line in stdout.splitlines():
+            package_id = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip()
+            if package_id.lower() == candidate.lower():
+                return package_id
+        return None
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        token = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if token.lower() == candidate.lower():
+            return token
+    return None
+
+
+def _query_command(manager: str, executable: str, candidate: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [
+            executable,
+            "search",
+            "--query",
+            candidate,
+            "--source",
+            "winget",
+            "--accept-source-agreements",
+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", candidate, "--exact", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", candidate]

+def _invocation_executable(display_executable: str) -> str:
+    if LOCAL_APPDATA:
+        return display_executable.replace("%LOCALAPPDATA%", LOCAL_APPDATA)
+    return display_executable

+def _query_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict) -> dict:
+    """기존 로컬 패키지 관리자에서 SAT 후보별 회답을 반환한다."""
+    rows = {}
+    for candidate in SAT_CANDIDATES:
+        queries = []
+        selected = None
+        for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+            if not manager_row["available"]:
+                continue
+            executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+            args = _query_command(manager, executable, candidate)
+            result = _run(args)
+            package_id = _package_id(manager, result["stdout"], candidate)
+            query = {
+                "manager": manager,
+                "command": result["command"],
+                "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
+                "stdout": result["stdout"],
+                "stderr": result["stderr"],
+                "package_id": package_id,
+                "available": result["exit_code"] == 0 and package_id is not None,
+            }
+            queries.append(query)
+            if selected is None and query["available"]:
+                selected = query
+        rows[candidate] = {
+            "package_queries": queries,
+            "available": selected is not None,
+            "package_manager": selected["manager"] if selected else None,
+            "package_id": selected["package_id"] if selected else None,
+        }
+    return rows

+def _local_package_managers() -> dict:
+    """PATH 탐색과 실행 가능한 승인 별칭 경로를 분리해 반환한다."""
+    managers = {}
+    for name in ("winget", "choco", "scoop"):
+        path_lookup = _run(["where.exe", name])
+        executable = None
+        discovery = "none"
+        probe = None
+        if path_lookup["exit_code"] == 0 and path_lookup["stdout"]:
+            executable = path_lookup["stdout"].splitlines()[0]
+            discovery = "PATH"
+        elif name == "winget" and WINGET_FALLBACK.is_file():
+            fallback_probe = _run([str(WINGET_FALLBACK), "--version"])
+            if fallback_probe["exit_code"] == 0:
+                executable = str(WINGET_FALLBACK)
+                discovery = "windowsapps_alias"
+                probe = fallback_probe
+        if executable and probe is None:
+            probe_args = [executable, "--version"] if name != "choco" else [executable, "--version"]
+            probe = _run(probe_args)
+        available = bool(executable and probe and probe["exit_code"] == 0)
+        managers[name] = {
+            "name": name,
+            "path_lookup": path_lookup,
+            "discovery": discovery if available else "none",
+            "executable": _redact(executable) if available else "없음",
+            "probe": probe,
+            "available": available,
+        }
+    return managers
+
+
+def _package_id(manager: str, stdout: str, candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    """패키지 관리자의 기계 판독 가능한 출력에서 패키지 ID를 읽는다."""
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return matches[0] if matches else None
+    if manager == "choco":
+        for line in stdout.splitlines():
+            package_id = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip()
+            if package_id.lower() == candidate.lower():
+                return package_id
+        return None
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        token = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if token.lower() == candidate.lower():
+            return token
+    return None
+
+
+def _query_command(manager: str, executable: str, candidate: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [
+            executable,
+            "search",
+            "--query",
+            candidate,
+            "--source",
+            "winget",
+            "--accept-source-agreements",
+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", candidate, "--exact", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", candidate]

+def _invocation_executable(display_executable: str) -> str:
+    if LOCAL_APPDATA:
+        return display_executable.replace("%LOCALAPPDATA%", LOCAL_APPDATA)
+    return display_executable

+def _query_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict) -> dict:
+    """기존 로컬 패키지 관리자에서 SAT 후보별 회답을 반환한다."""
+    rows = {}
+    for candidate in SAT_CANDIDATES:
+        queries = []
+        selected = None
+        for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+            if not manager_row["available"]:
+                continue
+            executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+            args = _query_command(manager, executable, candidate)
+            result = _run(args)
+            package_id = _package_id(manager, result["stdout"], candidate)
+            query = {
+                "manager": manager,
+                "command": result["command"],
+                "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
+                "stdout": result["stdout"],
+                "stderr": result["stderr"],
+                "package_id": package_id,
+                "available": result["exit_code"] == 0 and package_id is not None,
+            }
+            queries.append(query)
+            if selected is None and query["available"]:
+                selected = query
+        rows[candidate] = {
+            "package_queries": queries,
+            "available": selected is not None,
+            "package_manager": selected["manager"] if selected else None,
+            "package_id": selected["package_id"] if selected else None,
+        }
+    return rows

+def _installed_winget_executable(package_id: str, executable_name: str) -> Path | None:
+    package_root = Path(LOCAL_APPDATA) / "Microsoft" / "WinGet" / "Packages"
+    if not package_root.is_dir():
+        return None

+def _measure_sat_candidate(name: str) -> dict:
