+def _install_command(manager: str, executable: str, package_id: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":

+        ]

+def install_available_sat_candidates(report: dict) -> list[dict]:

+                    "experiments/pvsnp/smoke/evidence/environment-changes.json"
+                ],
+            }
+        )
+    return events

 class ToolchainSmokeTest(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_path_invisible_winget_uses_only_executable_windowsapps_alias(self):
+        def fake_run(args, **_kwargs):
+            command = [str(value) for value in args]
+            if command[:2] == ["where.exe", "winget"]:
+                return {"command": "where.exe winget", "exit_code": 1, "stdout": "", "stderr": "not found"}
+            if command[-1] == "--version":
+                return {"command": "winget.exe --version", "exit_code": 0, "stdout": "v1", "stderr": ""}
+            return {"command": " ".join(command), "exit_code": 1, "stdout": "", "stderr": "not found"}
+
+        fallback = mock.Mock()
+        fallback.is_file.return_value = True
+        fallback.__str__ = mock.Mock(return_value="C:\\WindowsApps\\winget.exe")
+        with mock.patch.object(toolchain_smoke, "_run", side_effect=fake_run), mock.patch.object(
+            toolchain_smoke, "WINGET_FALLBACK", fallback
+        ):
+            managers = toolchain_smoke._local_package_managers()
+        winget = managers["winget"]
+        self.assertEqual("windowsapps_alias", winget["discovery"])
+        self.assertTrue(winget["available"])
+        self.assertEqual(1, winget["path_lookup"]["exit_code"])
+        self.assertEqual(0, winget["probe"]["exit_code"])
+

+def _local_package_managers() -> dict:
+    """PATH 탐색과 실행 가능한 승인 별칭 경로를 분리해 반환한다."""
+    managers = {}
+    for name in ("winget", "choco", "scoop"):
+        path_lookup = _run(["where.exe", name])
+        executable = None
+        discovery = "none"
+        probe = None
+        if path_lookup["exit_code"] == 0 and path_lookup["stdout"]:
+            executable = path_lookup["stdout"].splitlines()[0]
+            discovery = "PATH"
+        elif name == "winget" and WINGET_FALLBACK.is_file():
+            fallback_probe = _run([str(WINGET_FALLBACK), "--version"])
+            if fallback_probe["exit_code"] == 0:
+                executable = str(WINGET_FALLBACK)
+                discovery = "windowsapps_alias"
+                probe = fallback_probe
+        if executable and probe is None:
+            probe_args = [executable, "--version"] if name != "choco" else [executable, "--version"]
+            probe = _run(probe_args)
+        available = bool(executable and probe and probe["exit_code"] == 0)
+        managers[name] = {
+            "name": name,
+            "path_lookup": path_lookup,
+            "discovery": discovery if available else "none",
+            "executable": _redact(executable) if available else "없음",
+            "probe": probe,
+            "available": available,
+        }
+    return managers

+def _package_id(manager: str, stdout: str, candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    """패키지 관리자의 기계 판독 가능한 출력에서 패키지 ID를 읽는다."""
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return matches[0] if matches else None
+    if manager == "choco":
+        for line in stdout.splitlines():
+            package_id = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip()
+            if package_id.lower() == candidate.lower():
+                return package_id
+        return None
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        token = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if token.lower() == candidate.lower():
+            return token
+    return None
+

+def _query_command(manager: str, executable: str, candidate: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":

+            "search",

+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", candidate, "--exact", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", candidate]

+def _invocation_executable(display_executable: str) -> str:
+    if LOCAL_APPDATA:
+        return display_executable.replace("%LOCALAPPDATA%", LOCAL_APPDATA)

+def _query_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict) -> dict:
+    """기존 로컬 패키지 관리자에서 SAT 후보별 회답을 반환한다."""
+    rows = {}
+    for candidate in SAT_CANDIDATES:
+        queries = []
+        selected = None
+        for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+            if not manager_row["available"]:
+                continue
+            executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+            args = _query_command(manager, executable, candidate)
+            result = _run(args)
+            package_id = _package_id(manager, result["stdout"], candidate)
+            query = {
+                "manager": manager,
+                "command": result["command"],
+                "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
+                "stdout": result["stdout"],
+                "stderr": result["stderr"],
+                "package_id": package_id,
+                "available": result["exit_code"] == 0 and package_id is not None,
+            }
+            queries.append(query)
+            if selected is None and query["available"]:
+                selected = query
+        rows[candidate] = {
+            "package_queries": queries,
+            "available": selected is not None,
+            "package_manager": selected["manager"] if selected else None,
+            "package_id": selected["package_id"] if selected else None,
+        }
+    return rows

 class ToolchainSmokeTest(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_path_invisible_winget_uses_only_executable_windowsapps_alias(self):
+        def fake_run(args, **_kwargs):
+            command = [str(value) for value in args]
+            if command[:2] == ["where.exe", "winget"]:
+                return {"command": "where.exe winget", "exit_code": 1, "stdout": "", "stderr": "not found"}
+            if command[-1] == "--version":
+                return {"command": "winget.exe --version", "exit_code": 0, "stdout": "v1", "stderr": ""}
+            return {"command": " ".join(command), "exit_code": 1, "stdout": "", "stderr": "not found"}
+
+        fallback = mock.Mock()
+        fallback.is_file.return_value = True
+        fallback.__str__ = mock.Mock(return_value="C:\\WindowsApps\\winget.exe")
+        with mock.patch.object(toolchain_smoke, "_run", side_effect=fake_run), mock.patch.object(
+            toolchain_smoke, "WINGET_FALLBACK", fallback
+        ):
+            managers = toolchain_smoke._local_package_managers()
+        winget = managers["winget"]
+        self.assertEqual("windowsapps_alias", winget["discovery"])
+        self.assertTrue(winget["available"])
+        self.assertEqual(1, winget["path_lookup"]["exit_code"])
+        self.assertEqual(0, winget["probe"]["exit_code"])

+def _local_package_managers() -> dict:
+    """PATH 탐색과 실행 가능한 승인 별칭 경로를 분리해 반환한다."""
+    managers = {}
+    for name in ("winget", "choco", "scoop"):
+        path_lookup = _run(["where.exe", name])
+        executable = None
+        discovery = "none"
+        probe = None
+        if path_lookup["exit_code"] == 0 and path_lookup["stdout"]:
+            executable = path_lookup["stdout"].splitlines()[0]
+            discovery = "PATH"
+        elif name == "winget" and WINGET_FALLBACK.is_file():
+            fallback_probe = _run([str(WINGET_FALLBACK), "--version"])
+            if fallback_probe["exit_code"] == 0:
+                executable = str(WINGET_FALLBACK)
+                discovery = "windowsapps_alias"
+                probe = fallback_probe
+        if executable and probe is None:
+            probe_args = [executable, "--version"] if name != "choco" else [executable, "--version"]
+            probe = _run(probe_args)
+        available = bool(executable and probe and probe["exit_code"] == 0)
+        managers[name] = {
+            "name": name,
+            "path_lookup": path_lookup,
+            "discovery": discovery if available else "none",
+            "executable": _redact(executable) if available else "없음",
+            "probe": probe,
+            "available": available,
+        }
+    return managers

+def _package_id(manager: str, stdout: str, candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    """패키지 관리자의 기계 판독 가능한 출력에서 패키지 ID를 읽는다."""
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return matches[0] if matches else None
+    if manager == "choco":
+        for line in stdout.splitlines():
+            package_id = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip()
+            if package_id.lower() == candidate.lower():
+                return package_id
+        return None
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        token = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if token.lower() == candidate.lower():
+            return token
+    return None
+

+def _query_command(manager: str, executable: str, candidate: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":

+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":

+    return [executable, "search", candidate]

+def _query_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict) -> dict:
+    """기존 로컬 패키지 관리자에서 SAT 후보별 회답을 반환한다."""
+    rows = {}
+    for candidate in SAT_CANDIDATES:
+        queries = []
+        selected = None
+        for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+            if not manager_row["available"]:
+                continue
+            executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+            args = _query_command(manager, executable, candidate)
+            result = _run(args)
+            package_id = _package_id(manager, result["stdout"], candidate)
+            query = {
+                "manager": manager,
+                "command": result["command"],
+                "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
+                "stdout": result["stdout"],
+                "stderr": result["stderr"],
+                "package_id": package_id,
+                "available": result["exit_code"] == 0 and package_id is not None,
+            }
+            queries.append(query)
+            if selected is None and query["available"]:
+                selected = query
+        rows[candidate] = {
+            "package_queries": queries,
+            "available": selected is not None,
+            "package_manager": selected["manager"] if selected else None,
+            "package_id": selected["package_id"] if selected else None,
+        }
+    return rows

 ## 5. SAT 실행 파일 판정표
 
-공식 경로는 [MiniSat 저장소](https://github.com/niklasso/minisat), [CaDiCaL 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/cadical/releases), [Kissat 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/kissat/releases), [CryptoMiniSat 릴리스](https://github.com/msoos/cryptominisat/releases)다. 현재 로컬 패키지 관리자가 없으므로 공식 사전 빌드 자산만 확보 경로로 인정했다. 조사 중 Windows x64에서 직접 실행할 추가 SAT 실행 파일 후보는 발견하지 못했다.
+공식 경로는 [MiniSat 저장소](https://github.com/niklasso/minisat), [CaDiCaL 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/cadical/releases), [Kissat 릴리스](https://github.com/arminbiere/kissat/releases), [CryptoMiniSat 릴리스](https://github.com/msoos/cryptominisat/releases)다. 실행 가능한 기존 `winget`으로 최소 후보 4종을 전건 조회했다. 조회 중 추가 SAT 후보는 발견하지 못했다.

 class ToolchainSmokeTest(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_path_invisible_winget_uses_only_executable_windowsapps_alias(self):
+        def fake_run(args, **_kwargs):
+            command = [str(value) for value in args]
+            if command[:2] == ["where.exe", "winget"]:
+                return {"command": "where.exe winget", "exit_code": 1, "stdout": "", "stderr": "not found"}
+            if command[-1] == "--version":
+                return {"command": "winget.exe --version", "exit_code": 0, "stdout": "v1", "stderr": ""}
+            return {"command": " ".join(command), "exit_code": 1, "stdout": "", "stderr": "not found"}
+
+        fallback = mock.Mock()
+        fallback.is_file.return_value = True
+        fallback.__str__ = mock.Mock(return_value="C:\\WindowsApps\\winget.exe")
+        with mock.patch.object(toolchain_smoke, "_run", side_effect=fake_run), mock.patch.object(
+            toolchain_smoke, "WINGET_FALLBACK", fallback
+        ):
+            managers = toolchain_smoke._local_package_managers()
+        winget = managers["winget"]
+        self.assertEqual("windowsapps_alias", winget["discovery"])
+        self.assertTrue(winget["available"])
+        self.assertEqual(1, winget["path_lookup"]["exit_code"])
+        self.assertEqual(0, winget["probe"]["exit_code"])
+
+    def test_candidate_queries_have_complete_structure_and_derive_availability(self):
+        managers = {

+                "available": True,
+                "executable": "winget.exe",

+        }

+            "cadical": "No package found matching input criteria.",
+            "kissat": "No package found matching input criteria.",
+            "cryptominisat": "No package found matching input criteria.",
+        }
+
+        def fake_run(args, **_kwargs):
+            candidate = str(args[3])
+            stdout = responses[candidate]
+            return {
+                "command": " ".join(str(value) for value in args),
+                "exit_code": 0 if candidate == "minisat" else 1,
+                "stdout": stdout,
+                "stderr": "",
+            }
+
+        with mock.patch.object(toolchain_smoke, "_run", side_effect=fake_run):
+            rows = toolchain_smoke._query_sat_candidates(managers)
+        self.assertEqual(set(toolchain_smoke.SAT_CANDIDATES), set(rows))
+        required = {"manager", "command", "exit_code", "stdout", "stderr", "package_id", "available"}
+        for row in rows.values():
+            self.assertEqual(required, set(row["package_queries"][0]))
+        self.assertTrue(rows["minisat"]["available"])
+        self.assertEqual("PolarGoose.minisat", rows["minisat"]["package_id"])
+        self.assertFalse(rows["cadical"]["available"])

+def _local_package_managers() -> dict:
+    """PATH 탐색과 실행 가능한 승인 별칭 경로를 분리해 반환한다."""
+    managers = {}
+    for name in ("winget", "choco", "scoop"):
+        path_lookup = _run(["where.exe", name])
+        executable = None
+        discovery = "none"
+        probe = None
+        if path_lookup["exit_code"] == 0 and path_lookup["stdout"]:
+            executable = path_lookup["stdout"].splitlines()[0]
+            discovery = "PATH"
+        elif name == "winget" and WINGET_FALLBACK.is_file():
+            fallback_probe = _run([str(WINGET_FALLBACK), "--version"])
+            if fallback_probe["exit_code"] == 0:
+                executable = str(WINGET_FALLBACK)
+                discovery = "windowsapps_alias"
+                probe = fallback_probe
+        if executable and probe is None:
+            probe_args = [executable, "--version"] if name != "choco" else [executable, "--version"]
+            probe = _run(probe_args)
+        available = bool(executable and probe and probe["exit_code"] == 0)
+        managers[name] = {
+            "name": name,
+            "path_lookup": path_lookup,
+            "discovery": discovery if available else "none",
+            "executable": _redact(executable) if available else "없음",
+            "probe": probe,
+            "available": available,
+        }
+    return managers
+

+def _package_id(manager: str, stdout: str, candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    """패키지 관리자의 기계 판독 가능한 출력에서 패키지 ID를 읽는다."""
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return matches[0] if matches else None
+    if manager == "choco":
+        for line in stdout.splitlines():
+            package_id = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip()
+            if package_id.lower() == candidate.lower():
+                return package_id
+        return None
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        token = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if token.lower() == candidate.lower():
+            return token
+    return None
+
+
+def _query_command(manager: str, executable: str, candidate: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [
+            executable,
+            "search",
+            "--query",
+            candidate,
+            "--source",
+            "winget",
+            "--accept-source-agreements",
+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", candidate, "--exact", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", candidate]

+def _invocation_executable(display_executable: str) -> str:
+    if LOCAL_APPDATA:
+        return display_executable.replace("%LOCALAPPDATA%", LOCAL_APPDATA)
+    return display_executable

+def _query_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict) -> dict:
+    """기존 로컬 패키지 관리자에서 SAT 후보별 회답을 반환한다."""
+    rows = {}
+    for candidate in SAT_CANDIDATES:
+        queries = []
+        selected = None
+        for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+            if not manager_row["available"]:
+                continue
+            executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+            args = _query_command(manager, executable, candidate)
+            result = _run(args)
+            package_id = _package_id(manager, result["stdout"], candidate)
+            query = {
+                "manager": manager,
+                "command": result["command"],
+                "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
+                "stdout": result["stdout"],
+                "stderr": result["stderr"],
+                "package_id": package_id,
+                "available": result["exit_code"] == 0 and package_id is not None,
+            }
+            queries.append(query)
+            if selected is None and query["available"]:
+                selected = query
+        rows[candidate] = {
+            "package_queries": queries,
+            "available": selected is not None,
+            "package_manager": selected["manager"] if selected else None,
+            "package_id": selected["package_id"] if selected else None,
+        }
+    return rows

 class ToolchainSmokeTest(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_path_invisible_winget_uses_only_executable_windowsapps_alias(self):
+        def fake_run(args, **_kwargs):
+            command = [str(value) for value in args]
+            if command[:2] == ["where.exe", "winget"]:
+                return {"command": "where.exe winget", "exit_code": 1, "stdout": "", "stderr": "not found"}
+            if command[-1] == "--version":
+                return {"command": "winget.exe --version", "exit_code": 0, "stdout": "v1", "stderr": ""}
+            return {"command": " ".join(command), "exit_code": 1, "stdout": "", "stderr": "not found"}
+
+        fallback = mock.Mock()
+        fallback.is_file.return_value = True
+        fallback.__str__ = mock.Mock(return_value="C:\\WindowsApps\\winget.exe")
+        with mock.patch.object(toolchain_smoke, "_run", side_effect=fake_run), mock.patch.object(
+            toolchain_smoke, "WINGET_FALLBACK", fallback
+        ):
+            managers = toolchain_smoke._local_package_managers()
+        winget = managers["winget"]
+        self.assertEqual("windowsapps_alias", winget["discovery"])
+        self.assertTrue(winget["available"])
+        self.assertEqual(1, winget["path_lookup"]["exit_code"])
+        self.assertEqual(0, winget["probe"]["exit_code"])
+
+    def test_candidate_queries_have_complete_structure_and_derive_availability(self):
+        managers = {
+            "winget": {
+                "name": "winget",
+                "available": True,
+                "executable": "winget.exe",
+            }
+        }
+        responses = {
+            "minisat": "Name MiniSat Id PolarGoose.minisat Version 2.2",
+            "cadical": "No package found matching input criteria.",
+            "kissat": "No package found matching input criteria.",
+            "cryptominisat": "No package found matching input criteria.",
+        }
+
+        def fake_run(args, **_kwargs):
+            candidate = str(args[3])
+            stdout = responses[candidate]
+            return {
+                "command": " ".join(str(value) for value in args),
+                "exit_code": 0 if candidate == "minisat" else 1,
+                "stdout": stdout,
+                "stderr": "",
+            }
+
+        with mock.patch.object(toolchain_smoke, "_run", side_effect=fake_run):
+            rows = toolchain_smoke._query_sat_candidates(managers)
+        self.assertEqual(set(toolchain_smoke.SAT_CANDIDATES), set(rows))
+        required = {"manager", "command", "exit_code", "stdout", "stderr", "package_id", "available"}
+        for row in rows.values():
+            self.assertEqual(required, set(row["package_queries"][0]))
+        self.assertTrue(rows["minisat"]["available"])
+        self.assertEqual("PolarGoose.minisat", rows["minisat"]["package_id"])
+        self.assertFalse(rows["cadical"]["available"])
+
+    def test_all_available_candidates_are_installed_and_remeasured(self):

+        install_results = iter(

+def _local_package_managers() -> dict:
+    """PATH 탐색과 실행 가능한 승인 별칭 경로를 분리해 반환한다."""
+    managers = {}
+    for name in ("winget", "choco", "scoop"):
+        path_lookup = _run(["where.exe", name])
+        executable = None
+        discovery = "none"
+        probe = None
+        if path_lookup["exit_code"] == 0 and path_lookup["stdout"]:
+            executable = path_lookup["stdout"].splitlines()[0]
+            discovery = "PATH"
+        elif name == "winget" and WINGET_FALLBACK.is_file():
+            fallback_probe = _run([str(WINGET_FALLBACK), "--version"])
+            if fallback_probe["exit_code"] == 0:
+                executable = str(WINGET_FALLBACK)
+                discovery = "windowsapps_alias"
+                probe = fallback_probe
+        if executable and probe is None:
+            probe_args = [executable, "--version"] if name != "choco" else [executable, "--version"]
+            probe = _run(probe_args)
+        available = bool(executable and probe and probe["exit_code"] == 0)
+        managers[name] = {
+            "name": name,
+            "path_lookup": path_lookup,
+            "discovery": discovery if available else "none",
+            "executable": _redact(executable) if available else "없음",
+            "probe": probe,
+            "available": available,
+        }
+    return managers
+

+def _package_id(manager: str, stdout: str, candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    """패키지 관리자의 기계 판독 가능한 출력에서 패키지 ID를 읽는다."""
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return matches[0] if matches else None
+    if manager == "choco":
+        for line in stdout.splitlines():
+            package_id = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip()
+            if package_id.lower() == candidate.lower():
+                return package_id
+        return None
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        token = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if token.lower() == candidate.lower():
+            return token
+    return None
+
+
+def _query_command(manager: str, executable: str, candidate: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [
+            executable,
+            "search",
+            "--query",
+            candidate,
+            "--source",
+            "winget",
+            "--accept-source-agreements",
+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", candidate, "--exact", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", candidate]

+def _invocation_executable(display_executable: str) -> str:
+    if LOCAL_APPDATA:

+def _query_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict) -> dict:
+    """기존 로컬 패키지 관리자에서 SAT 후보별 회답을 반환한다."""
+    rows = {}
+    for candidate in SAT_CANDIDATES:
+        queries = []
+        selected = None
+        for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+            if not manager_row["available"]:
+                continue
+            executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+            args = _query_command(manager, executable, candidate)
+            result = _run(args)
+            package_id = _package_id(manager, result["stdout"], candidate)
+            query = {
+                "manager": manager,
+                "command": result["command"],
+                "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
+                "stdout": result["stdout"],
+                "stderr": result["stderr"],
+                "package_id": package_id,
+                "available": result["exit_code"] == 0 and package_id is not None,
+            }
+            queries.append(query)
+            if selected is None and query["available"]:
+                selected = query
+        rows[candidate] = {
+            "package_queries": queries,
+            "available": selected is not None,
+            "package_manager": selected["manager"] if selected else None,
+            "package_id": selected["package_id"] if selected else None,
+        }
+    return rows

 class ToolchainSmokeTest(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_path_invisible_winget_uses_only_executable_windowsapps_alias(self):
+        def fake_run(args, **_kwargs):
+            command = [str(value) for value in args]
+            if command[:2] == ["where.exe", "winget"]:
+                return {"command": "where.exe winget", "exit_code": 1, "stdout": "", "stderr": "not found"}
+            if command[-1] == "--version":
+                return {"command": "winget.exe --version", "exit_code": 0, "stdout": "v1", "stderr": ""}
+            return {"command": " ".join(command), "exit_code": 1, "stdout": "", "stderr": "not found"}
+
+        fallback = mock.Mock()
+        fallback.is_file.return_value = True
+        fallback.__str__ = mock.Mock(return_value="C:\\WindowsApps\\winget.exe")
+        with mock.patch.object(toolchain_smoke, "_run", side_effect=fake_run), mock.patch.object(
+            toolchain_smoke, "WINGET_FALLBACK", fallback
+        ):
+            managers = toolchain_smoke._local_package_managers()
+        winget = managers["winget"]
+        self.assertEqual("windowsapps_alias", winget["discovery"])
+        self.assertTrue(winget["available"])
+        self.assertEqual(1, winget["path_lookup"]["exit_code"])
+        self.assertEqual(0, winget["probe"]["exit_code"])
+

+def _local_package_managers() -> dict:
+    """PATH 탐색과 실행 가능한 승인 별칭 경로를 분리해 반환한다."""
+    managers = {}
+    for name in ("winget", "choco", "scoop"):
+        path_lookup = _run(["where.exe", name])
+        executable = None
+        discovery = "none"
+        probe = None
+        if path_lookup["exit_code"] == 0 and path_lookup["stdout"]:
+            executable = path_lookup["stdout"].splitlines()[0]
+            discovery = "PATH"
+        elif name == "winget" and WINGET_FALLBACK.is_file():
+            fallback_probe = _run([str(WINGET_FALLBACK), "--version"])
+            if fallback_probe["exit_code"] == 0:
+                executable = str(WINGET_FALLBACK)
+                discovery = "windowsapps_alias"
+                probe = fallback_probe
+        if executable and probe is None:
+            probe_args = [executable, "--version"] if name != "choco" else [executable, "--version"]
+            probe = _run(probe_args)
+        available = bool(executable and probe and probe["exit_code"] == 0)
+        managers[name] = {
+            "name": name,
+            "path_lookup": path_lookup,
+            "discovery": discovery if available else "none",
+            "executable": _redact(executable) if available else "없음",
+            "probe": probe,
+            "available": available,
+        }
+    return managers

+def _package_id(manager: str, stdout: str, candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    """패키지 관리자의 기계 판독 가능한 출력에서 패키지 ID를 읽는다."""
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return matches[0] if matches else None
+    if manager == "choco":
+        for line in stdout.splitlines():
+            package_id = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip()
+            if package_id.lower() == candidate.lower():
+                return package_id
+        return None
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        token = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if token.lower() == candidate.lower():
+            return token
+    return None
+

+def _query_command(manager: str, executable: str, candidate: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [
+            executable,
+            "search",
+            "--query",
+            candidate,
+            "--source",
+            "winget",
+            "--accept-source-agreements",
+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", candidate, "--exact", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", candidate]

+def _invocation_executable(display_executable: str) -> str:

+def _query_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict) -> dict:
+    """기존 로컬 패키지 관리자에서 SAT 후보별 회답을 반환한다."""
+    rows = {}
+    for candidate in SAT_CANDIDATES:
+        queries = []
+        selected = None
+        for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+            if not manager_row["available"]:
+                continue
+            executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+            args = _query_command(manager, executable, candidate)
+            result = _run(args)
+            package_id = _package_id(manager, result["stdout"], candidate)
+            query = {
+                "manager": manager,
+                "command": result["command"],
+                "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
+                "stdout": result["stdout"],
+                "stderr": result["stderr"],
+                "package_id": package_id,
+                "available": result["exit_code"] == 0 and package_id is not None,
+            }
+            queries.append(query)
+            if selected is None and query["available"]:
+                selected = query
+        rows[candidate] = {
+            "package_queries": queries,
+            "available": selected is not None,
+            "package_manager": selected["manager"] if selected else None,
+            "package_id": selected["package_id"] if selected else None,
+        }
+    return rows

+def _local_package_managers() -> dict:
+    """PATH 탐색과 실행 가능한 승인 별칭 경로를 분리해 반환한다."""
+    managers = {}
+    for name in ("winget", "choco", "scoop"):
+        path_lookup = _run(["where.exe", name])
+        executable = None
+        discovery = "none"
+        probe = None
+        if path_lookup["exit_code"] == 0 and path_lookup["stdout"]:
+            executable = path_lookup["stdout"].splitlines()[0]
+            discovery = "PATH"
+        elif name == "winget" and WINGET_FALLBACK.is_file():
+            fallback_probe = _run([str(WINGET_FALLBACK), "--version"])
+            if fallback_probe["exit_code"] == 0:
+                executable = str(WINGET_FALLBACK)
+                discovery = "windowsapps_alias"
+                probe = fallback_probe
+        if executable and probe is None:
+            probe_args = [executable, "--version"] if name != "choco" else [executable, "--version"]
+            probe = _run(probe_args)
+        available = bool(executable and probe and probe["exit_code"] == 0)
+        managers[name] = {
+            "name": name,
+            "path_lookup": path_lookup,
+            "discovery": discovery if available else "none",
+            "executable": _redact(executable) if available else "없음",
+            "probe": probe,
+            "available": available,
+        }
+    return managers
+
+
+def _package_id(manager: str, stdout: str, candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    """패키지 관리자의 기계 판독 가능한 출력에서 패키지 ID를 읽는다."""
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return matches[0] if matches else None
+    if manager == "choco":
+        for line in stdout.splitlines():
+            package_id = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip()
+            if package_id.lower() == candidate.lower():
+                return package_id
+        return None
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        token = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if token.lower() == candidate.lower():
+            return token
+    return None
+
+
+def _query_command(manager: str, executable: str, candidate: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [
+            executable,
+            "search",
+            "--query",
+            candidate,
+            "--source",
+            "winget",
+            "--accept-source-agreements",
+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", candidate, "--exact", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", candidate]

+def _invocation_executable(display_executable: str) -> str:
+    if LOCAL_APPDATA:
+        return display_executable.replace("%LOCALAPPDATA%", LOCAL_APPDATA)
+    return display_executable

+def _query_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict) -> dict:
+    """기존 로컬 패키지 관리자에서 SAT 후보별 회답을 반환한다."""
+    rows = {}
+    for candidate in SAT_CANDIDATES:
+        queries = []
+        selected = None
+        for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+            if not manager_row["available"]:
+                continue
+            executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+            args = _query_command(manager, executable, candidate)
+            result = _run(args)
+            package_id = _package_id(manager, result["stdout"], candidate)
+            query = {
+                "manager": manager,
+                "command": result["command"],
+                "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
+                "stdout": result["stdout"],
+                "stderr": result["stderr"],
+                "package_id": package_id,
+                "available": result["exit_code"] == 0 and package_id is not None,
+            }
+            queries.append(query)
+            if selected is None and query["available"]:
+                selected = query
+        rows[candidate] = {
+            "package_queries": queries,
+            "available": selected is not None,
+            "package_manager": selected["manager"] if selected else None,
+            "package_id": selected["package_id"] if selected else None,
+        }
+    return rows

+    def test_path_invisible_winget_uses_only_executable_windowsapps_alias(self):
+        def fake_run(args, **_kwargs):
+            command = [str(value) for value in args]
+            if command[:2] == ["where.exe", "winget"]:

+            if command[-1] == "--version":
+                return {"command": "winget.exe --version", "exit_code": 0, "stdout": "v1", "stderr": ""}

+        fallback = mock.Mock()

+            toolchain_smoke, "WINGET_FALLBACK", fallback

+def _local_package_managers() -> dict:
+    """PATH 탐색과 실행 가능한 승인 별칭 경로를 분리해 반환한다."""
+    managers = {}
+    for name in ("winget", "choco", "scoop"):
+        path_lookup = _run(["where.exe", name])
+        executable = None
+        discovery = "none"
+        probe = None
+        if path_lookup["exit_code"] == 0 and path_lookup["stdout"]:
+            executable = path_lookup["stdout"].splitlines()[0]
+            discovery = "PATH"
+        elif name == "winget" and WINGET_FALLBACK.is_file():
+            fallback_probe = _run([str(WINGET_FALLBACK), "--version"])
+            if fallback_probe["exit_code"] == 0:
+                executable = str(WINGET_FALLBACK)
+                discovery = "windowsapps_alias"
+                probe = fallback_probe
+        if executable and probe is None:
+            probe_args = [executable, "--version"] if name != "choco" else [executable, "--version"]
+            probe = _run(probe_args)
+        available = bool(executable and probe and probe["exit_code"] == 0)
+        managers[name] = {
+            "name": name,
+            "path_lookup": path_lookup,
+            "discovery": discovery if available else "none",
+            "executable": _redact(executable) if available else "없음",
+            "probe": probe,
+            "available": available,
+        }
+    return managers
+
+
+def _package_id(manager: str, stdout: str, candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    """패키지 관리자의 기계 판독 가능한 출력에서 패키지 ID를 읽는다."""
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return matches[0] if matches else None
+    if manager == "choco":
+        for line in stdout.splitlines():
+            package_id = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip()
+            if package_id.lower() == candidate.lower():
+                return package_id
+        return None
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        token = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if token.lower() == candidate.lower():
+            return token
+    return None
+
+
+def _query_command(manager: str, executable: str, candidate: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [
+            executable,
+            "search",
+            "--query",
+            candidate,
+            "--source",
+            "winget",
+            "--accept-source-agreements",
+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", candidate, "--exact", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", candidate]
+

+def _invocation_executable(display_executable: str) -> str:
+    if LOCAL_APPDATA:
+        return display_executable.replace("%LOCALAPPDATA%", LOCAL_APPDATA)
+    return display_executable
+

+def _query_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict) -> dict:
+    """기존 로컬 패키지 관리자에서 SAT 후보별 회답을 반환한다."""
+    rows = {}
+    for candidate in SAT_CANDIDATES:
+        queries = []
+        selected = None
+        for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+            if not manager_row["available"]:
+                continue
+            executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+            args = _query_command(manager, executable, candidate)
+            result = _run(args)
+            package_id = _package_id(manager, result["stdout"], candidate)
+            query = {
+                "manager": manager,
+                "command": result["command"],
+                "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
+                "stdout": result["stdout"],
+                "stderr": result["stderr"],
+                "package_id": package_id,
+                "available": result["exit_code"] == 0 and package_id is not None,
+            }
+            queries.append(query)
+            if selected is None and query["available"]:
+                selected = query
+        rows[candidate] = {
+            "package_queries": queries,
+            "available": selected is not None,
+            "package_manager": selected["manager"] if selected else None,
+            "package_id": selected["package_id"] if selected else None,
+        }
+    return rows

+    def test_path_invisible_winget_uses_only_executable_windowsapps_alias(self):

+            command = [str(value) for value in args]
+            if command[:2] == ["where.exe", "winget"]:

+            if command[-1] == "--version":
+                return {"command": "winget.exe --version", "exit_code": 0, "stdout": "v1", "stderr": ""}

+        fallback = mock.Mock()

+            toolchain_smoke, "WINGET_FALLBACK", fallback

+def _local_package_managers() -> dict:
+    """PATH 탐색과 실행 가능한 승인 별칭 경로를 분리해 반환한다."""
+    managers = {}
+    for name in ("winget", "choco", "scoop"):
+        path_lookup = _run(["where.exe", name])
+        executable = None
+        discovery = "none"
+        probe = None
+        if path_lookup["exit_code"] == 0 and path_lookup["stdout"]:
+            executable = path_lookup["stdout"].splitlines()[0]
+            discovery = "PATH"
+        elif name == "winget" and WINGET_FALLBACK.is_file():
+            fallback_probe = _run([str(WINGET_FALLBACK), "--version"])
+            if fallback_probe["exit_code"] == 0:
+                executable = str(WINGET_FALLBACK)
+                discovery = "windowsapps_alias"
+                probe = fallback_probe
+        if executable and probe is None:
+            probe_args = [executable, "--version"] if name != "choco" else [executable, "--version"]
+            probe = _run(probe_args)
+        available = bool(executable and probe and probe["exit_code"] == 0)
+        managers[name] = {
+            "name": name,
+            "path_lookup": path_lookup,
+            "discovery": discovery if available else "none",
+            "executable": _redact(executable) if available else "없음",
+            "probe": probe,
+            "available": available,
+        }
+    return managers
+
+
+def _package_id(manager: str, stdout: str, candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    """패키지 관리자의 기계 판독 가능한 출력에서 패키지 ID를 읽는다."""
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return matches[0] if matches else None
+    if manager == "choco":
+        for line in stdout.splitlines():
+            package_id = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip()
+            if package_id.lower() == candidate.lower():
+                return package_id
+        return None
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        package_name = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if package_name.lower() == candidate.lower():
+            return package_name
+    return None
+
+
+def _query_command(manager: str, executable: str, candidate: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [
+            executable,
+            "search",
+            "--query",
+            candidate,
+            "--source",
+            "winget",
+            "--accept-source-agreements",
+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", candidate, "--exact", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", candidate]
+
+
+def _invocation_executable(display_executable: str) -> str:
+    if LOCAL_APPDATA:
+        return display_executable.replace("%LOCALAPPDATA%", LOCAL_APPDATA)
+    return display_executable

+def _query_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict) -> dict:
+    """기존 로컬 패키지 관리자에서 SAT 후보별 회답을 반환한다."""
+    rows = {}
+    for candidate in SAT_CANDIDATES:
+        queries = []
+        selected = None
+        for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+            if not manager_row["available"]:
+                continue
+            executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+            args = _query_command(manager, executable, candidate)
+            result = _run(args)
+            package_id = _package_id(manager, result["stdout"], candidate)
+            query = {
+                "manager": manager,
+                "command": result["command"],
+                "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
+                "stdout": result["stdout"],
+                "stderr": result["stderr"],
+                "package_id": package_id,
+                "available": result["exit_code"] == 0 and package_id is not None,
+            }
+            queries.append(query)
+            if selected is None and query["available"]:
+                selected = query
+        rows[candidate] = {
+            "package_queries": queries,
+            "available": selected is not None,
+            "package_manager": selected["manager"] if selected else None,
+            "package_id": selected["package_id"] if selected else None,
+        }
+    return rows

+    def test_path_invisible_winget_uses_only_executable_windowsapps_alias(self):
+        def fake_run(args, **_kwargs):
+            command = [str(value) for value in args]
+            if command[:2] == ["where.exe", "winget"]:
+                return {"command": "where.exe winget", "exit_code": 1, "stdout": "", "stderr": "not found"}
+            if command[-1] == "--version":
+                return {"command": "winget.exe --version", "exit_code": 0, "stdout": "v1", "stderr": ""}
+            return {"command": " ".join(command), "exit_code": 1, "stdout": "", "stderr": "not found"}
+
+        fallback = mock.Mock()
+        fallback.is_file.return_value = True
+        fallback.__str__ = mock.Mock(return_value="C:\\WindowsApps\\winget.exe")
+        with mock.patch.object(toolchain_smoke, "_run", side_effect=fake_run), mock.patch.object(
+            toolchain_smoke, "WINGET_FALLBACK", fallback
+        ):
+            managers = toolchain_smoke._local_package_managers()
+        winget = managers["winget"]

+def _local_package_managers() -> dict:
+    """PATH 탐색과 실행 가능한 승인 별칭 경로를 분리해 반환한다."""
+    managers = {}
+    for name in ("winget", "choco", "scoop"):
+        path_lookup = _run(["where.exe", name])
+        executable = None
+        discovery = "none"
+        probe = None
+        if path_lookup["exit_code"] == 0 and path_lookup["stdout"]:
+            executable = path_lookup["stdout"].splitlines()[0]
+            discovery = "PATH"
+        elif name == "winget" and WINGET_FALLBACK.is_file():
+            fallback_probe = _run([str(WINGET_FALLBACK), "--version"])
+            if fallback_probe["exit_code"] == 0:
+                executable = str(WINGET_FALLBACK)
+                discovery = "windowsapps_alias"
+                probe = fallback_probe
+        if executable and probe is None:
+            probe_args = [executable, "--version"] if name != "choco" else [executable, "--version"]
+            probe = _run(probe_args)
+        available = bool(executable and probe and probe["exit_code"] == 0)
+        managers[name] = {
+            "name": name,
+            "path_lookup": path_lookup,
+            "discovery": discovery if available else "none",
+            "executable": _redact(executable) if available else "없음",
+            "probe": probe,
+            "available": available,
+        }
+    return managers
+
+
+def _package_id(manager: str, stdout: str, candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    """패키지 관리자의 기계 판독 가능한 출력에서 패키지 ID를 읽는다."""
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return matches[0] if matches else None
+    if manager == "choco":
+        for line in stdout.splitlines():
+            package_id = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip()
+            if package_id.lower() == candidate.lower():
+                return package_id
+        return None
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        package_name = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if package_name.lower() == candidate.lower():
+            return package_name
+    return None
+
+
+def _query_command(manager: str, executable: str, candidate: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [
+            executable,
+            "search",
+            "--query",
+            candidate,
+            "--source",
+            "winget",
+            "--accept-source-agreements",
+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", candidate, "--exact", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", candidate]
+
+
+def _invocation_executable(display_executable: str) -> str:
+    if LOCAL_APPDATA:
+        return display_executable.replace("%LOCALAPPDATA%", LOCAL_APPDATA)
+    return display_executable
+

+def _query_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict) -> dict:
+    """기존 로컬 패키지 관리자에서 SAT 후보별 회답을 반환한다."""
+    rows = {}
+    for candidate in SAT_CANDIDATES:
+        queries = []
+        selected = None
+        for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+            if not manager_row["available"]:
+                continue
+            executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+            args = _query_command(manager, executable, candidate)
+            result = _run(args)
+            package_id = _package_id(manager, result["stdout"], candidate)
+            query = {
+                "manager": manager,
+                "command": result["command"],
+                "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
+                "stdout": result["stdout"],
+                "stderr": result["stderr"],
+                "package_id": package_id,
+                "available": result["exit_code"] == 0 and package_id is not None,
+            }
+            queries.append(query)
+            if selected is None and query["available"]:
+                selected = query
+        rows[candidate] = {
+            "package_queries": queries,
+            "available": selected is not None,
+            "package_manager": selected["manager"] if selected else None,
+            "package_id": selected["package_id"] if selected else None,
+        }
+    return rows

+def _installed_winget_executable(package_id: str, executable_name: str) -> Path | None:

+    def test_path_invisible_winget_uses_only_executable_windowsapps_alias(self):
+        def fake_run(args, **_kwargs):
+            command = [str(value) for value in args]
+            if command[:2] == ["where.exe", "winget"]:
+                return {"command": "where.exe winget", "exit_code": 1, "stdout": "", "stderr": "not found"}
+            if command[-1] == "--version":
+                return {"command": "winget.exe --version", "exit_code": 0, "stdout": "v1", "stderr": ""}
+            return {"command": " ".join(command), "exit_code": 1, "stdout": "", "stderr": "not found"}
+
+        fallback = mock.Mock()
+        fallback.is_file.return_value = True
+        fallback.__str__ = mock.Mock(return_value="C:\\WindowsApps\\winget.exe")
+        with mock.patch.object(toolchain_smoke, "_run", side_effect=fake_run), mock.patch.object(
+            toolchain_smoke, "WINGET_FALLBACK", fallback
+        ):
+            managers = toolchain_smoke._local_package_managers()
+        winget = managers["winget"]
+        self.assertEqual("windowsapps_alias", winget["discovery"])
+        self.assertTrue(winget["available"])
+        self.assertEqual(1, winget["path_lookup"]["exit_code"])
+        self.assertEqual(0, winget["probe"]["exit_code"])

+def _local_package_managers() -> dict:
+    """PATH 탐색과 실행 가능한 승인 별칭 경로를 분리해 반환한다."""
+    managers = {}
+    for name in ("winget", "choco", "scoop"):
+        path_lookup = _run(["where.exe", name])
+        executable = None
+        discovery = "none"
+        probe = None
+        if path_lookup["exit_code"] == 0 and path_lookup["stdout"]:
+            executable = path_lookup["stdout"].splitlines()[0]
+            discovery = "PATH"
+        elif name == "winget" and WINGET_FALLBACK.is_file():
+            fallback_probe = _run([str(WINGET_FALLBACK), "--version"])
+            if fallback_probe["exit_code"] == 0:
+                executable = str(WINGET_FALLBACK)
+                discovery = "windowsapps_alias"
+                probe = fallback_probe
+        if executable and probe is None:
+            probe_args = [executable, "--version"] if name != "choco" else [executable, "--version"]
+            probe = _run(probe_args)
+        available = bool(executable and probe and probe["exit_code"] == 0)
+        managers[name] = {
+            "name": name,
+            "path_lookup": path_lookup,
+            "discovery": discovery if available else "none",
+            "executable": _redact(executable) if available else "없음",
+            "probe": probe,
+            "available": available,
+        }
+    return managers
+
+
+def _package_id(manager: str, stdout: str, candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    """패키지 관리자의 기계 판독 가능한 출력에서 패키지 ID를 읽는다."""
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return matches[0] if matches else None
+    if manager == "choco":
+        for line in stdout.splitlines():
+            package_id = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip()
+            if package_id.lower() == candidate.lower():
+                return package_id
+        return None
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        package_name = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if package_name.lower() == candidate.lower():
+            return package_name
+    return None
+
+
+def _query_command(manager: str, executable: str, candidate: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [
+            executable,
+            "search",
+            "--query",
+            candidate,
+            "--source",
+            "winget",
+            "--accept-source-agreements",
+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", candidate, "--exact", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", candidate]
+
+
+def _invocation_executable(display_executable: str) -> str:
+    if LOCAL_APPDATA:
+        return display_executable.replace("%LOCALAPPDATA%", LOCAL_APPDATA)
+    return display_executable
+
+
+def _query_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict) -> dict:
+    """기존 로컬 패키지 관리자에서 SAT 후보별 회답을 반환한다."""
+    rows = {}
+    for candidate in SAT_CANDIDATES:
+        queries = []
+        selected = None
+        for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+            if not manager_row["available"]:
+                continue
+            executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+            args = _query_command(manager, executable, candidate)
+            result = _run(args)
+            package_id = _package_id(manager, result["stdout"], candidate)
+            query = {
+                "manager": manager,
+                "command": result["command"],
+                "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
+                "stdout": result["stdout"],
+                "stderr": result["stderr"],
+                "package_id": package_id,
+                "available": result["exit_code"] == 0 and package_id is not None,
+            }
+            queries.append(query)
+            if selected is None and query["available"]:
+                selected = query
+        rows[candidate] = {
+            "package_queries": queries,
+            "available": selected is not None,
+            "package_manager": selected["manager"] if selected else None,
+            "package_id": selected["package_id"] if selected else None,
+        }
+    return rows

+def _installed_winget_executable(package_id: str, executable_name: str) -> Path | None:

+    def test_path_invisible_winget_uses_only_executable_windowsapps_alias(self):
+        def fake_run(args, **_kwargs):
+            command = [str(value) for value in args]
+            if command[:2] == ["where.exe", "winget"]:

+                return {"command": "winget.exe --version", "exit_code": 0, "stdout": "v1", "stderr": ""}
+            return {"command": " ".join(command), "exit_code": 1, "stdout": "", "stderr": "not found"}
+
+        fallback = mock.Mock()

+            toolchain_smoke, "WINGET_FALLBACK", fallback

+def _local_package_managers() -> dict:
+    """PATH 탐색과 실행 가능한 승인 별칭 경로를 분리해 반환한다."""
+    managers = {}
+    for name in ("winget", "choco", "scoop"):
+        path_lookup = _run(["where.exe", name])
+        executable = None
+        discovery = "none"
+        probe = None
+        if path_lookup["exit_code"] == 0 and path_lookup["stdout"]:
+            executable = path_lookup["stdout"].splitlines()[0]
+            discovery = "PATH"
+        elif name == "winget" and WINGET_FALLBACK.is_file():
+            fallback_probe = _run([str(WINGET_FALLBACK), "--version"])
+            if fallback_probe["exit_code"] == 0:
+                executable = str(WINGET_FALLBACK)
+                discovery = "windowsapps_alias"
+                probe = fallback_probe
+        if executable and probe is None:
+            probe_args = [executable, "--version"] if name != "choco" else [executable, "--version"]
+            probe = _run(probe_args)
+        available = bool(executable and probe and probe["exit_code"] == 0)
+        managers[name] = {
+            "name": name,
+            "path_lookup": path_lookup,
+            "discovery": discovery if available else "none",
+            "executable": _redact(executable) if available else "없음",
+            "probe": probe,
+            "available": available,
+        }
+    return managers
+
+
+def _package_id(manager: str, stdout: str, candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    """패키지 관리자의 기계 판독 가능한 출력에서 패키지 ID를 읽는다."""
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return matches[0] if matches else None
+    if manager == "choco":
+        for line in stdout.splitlines():
+            package_id = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip()
+            if package_id.lower() == candidate.lower():
+                return package_id
+        return None
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        package_name = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if package_name.lower() == candidate.lower():
+            return package_name
+    return None
+
+
+def _query_command(manager: str, executable: str, candidate: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [
+            executable,
+            "search",
+            "--query",
+            candidate,
+            "--source",
+            "winget",
+            "--accept-source-agreements",
+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", candidate, "--exact", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", candidate]
+
+
+def _invocation_executable(display_executable: str) -> str:
+    if LOCAL_APPDATA:
+        return display_executable.replace("%LOCALAPPDATA%", LOCAL_APPDATA)
+    return display_executable

+def _query_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict) -> dict:
+    """기존 로컬 패키지 관리자에서 SAT 후보별 회답을 반환한다."""
+    rows = {}
+    for candidate in SAT_CANDIDATES:
+        queries = []
+        selected = None
+        for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+            if not manager_row["available"]:
+                continue
+            executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+            args = _query_command(manager, executable, candidate)
+            result = _run(args)
+            package_id = _package_id(manager, result["stdout"], candidate)
+            query = {
+                "manager": manager,
+                "command": result["command"],
+                "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
+                "stdout": result["stdout"],
+                "stderr": result["stderr"],
+                "package_id": package_id,
+                "available": result["exit_code"] == 0 and package_id is not None,
+            }
+            queries.append(query)
+            if selected is None and query["available"]:
+                selected = query
+        rows[candidate] = {
+            "package_queries": queries,
+            "available": selected is not None,
+            "package_manager": selected["manager"] if selected else None,
+            "package_id": selected["package_id"] if selected else None,
+        }
+    return rows

+# 증거 부록
+
+## A. 로컬 패키지 관리자
+
+작업 디렉토리의 `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`은 `C:/Users/.../dag-wt/pvsnp-탐사-1+2.6`을 반환했다. `where.exe` 세 호출은 모두 exit 1이다. PATH 밖 `winget.exe --version`은 exit 0과 `v1.29.280`을 반환했다.
+
+## B. 후보별 조회
+
+`minisat`는 `winget` exit 0과 패키지 ID `PolarGoose.minisat`를 받았다. `cadical`, `kissat`, `cryptominisat`은 각각 exit 2316632084와 패키지 ID 부재를 받았다.
+
+## C. 설치 시도와 재측정
+
+`winget install --id PolarGoose.minisat --exact --source winget`은 exit 0이다. 설치 후 실행 파일 경로를 재탐색했다. SAT는 exit 10, UNSAT는 exit 20이어서 `PASS`다. 명령·대상·관리자·패키지 ID·stdout·stderr는 `I-SAT-MINISAT`에 있다.
+
+## D. 증거 종류 경계
+
+라이브 로그 3건의 `environment_change`, `recorded_event`, I-PY, I-Z3, I-CMS, I-SAT 검색은 0건이다. `environment-changes.json`은 I-PY, I-Z3, I-CMS, I-SAT-MINISAT 4건만 갖는다.
+
+## E. TDD RED·GREEN
+
+RED: `python experiments/pvsnp/smoke/test_toolchain_smoke.py` → exit 1. `NotImplementedError`, 사건 파일 부재, 라이브 로그의 `environment_change` 존재를 관찰했다.
+
+GREEN: 같은 명령 → exit 0, `Ran 8 tests in 22.797s`, `OK`. 추가 구조 교차검사는 `STRUCTURE_OK`를 출력했다.
+
+## F. CLI·재생성·안전 검사
+
+`python experiments/pvsnp/smoke/toolchain_smoke.py --json`은 exit 0이고 JSON 파싱을 통과했다. `python experiments/pvsnp/smoke/toolchain_smoke.py --evidence-dir experiments/pvsnp/smoke/evidence`는 exit 0이다. 대상 7파일의 크리덴셜·개인 경로·이메일 패턴 검색은 0건이다. `dag_check.py`는 exit 0과 `무발견`을 반환했다.

+    def test_path_invisible_winget_uses_only_executable_windowsapps_alias(self):
+        def fake_run(args, **_kwargs):
+            command = [str(value) for value in args]
+            if command[:2] == ["where.exe", "winget"]:
+                return {"command": "where.exe winget", "exit_code": 1, "stdout": "", "stderr": "not found"}
+            if command[-1] == "--version":
+                return {"command": "winget.exe --version", "exit_code": 0, "stdout": "v1", "stderr": ""}
+            return {"command": " ".join(command), "exit_code": 1, "stdout": "", "stderr": "not found"}
+
+        fallback = mock.Mock()
+        fallback.is_file.return_value = True
+        fallback.__str__ = mock.Mock(return_value="C:\\WindowsApps\\winget.exe")
+        with mock.patch.object(toolchain_smoke, "_run", side_effect=fake_run), mock.patch.object(
+            toolchain_smoke, "WINGET_FALLBACK", fallback
+        ):
+            managers = toolchain_smoke._local_package_managers()
+        winget = managers["winget"]
+        self.assertEqual("windowsapps_alias", winget["discovery"])
+        self.assertTrue(winget["available"])
+        self.assertEqual(1, winget["path_lookup"]["exit_code"])
+        self.assertEqual(0, winget["probe"]["exit_code"])

+def _local_package_managers() -> dict:
+    """PATH 탐색과 실행 가능한 승인 별칭 경로를 분리해 반환한다."""
+    managers = {}
+    for name in ("winget", "choco", "scoop"):
+        path_lookup = _run(["where.exe", name])
+        executable = None
+        discovery = "none"
+        probe = None
+        if path_lookup["exit_code"] == 0 and path_lookup["stdout"]:
+            executable = path_lookup["stdout"].splitlines()[0]
+            discovery = "PATH"
+        elif name == "winget" and WINGET_FALLBACK.is_file():
+            fallback_probe = _run([str(WINGET_FALLBACK), "--version"])
+            if fallback_probe["exit_code"] == 0:
+                executable = str(WINGET_FALLBACK)
+                discovery = "windowsapps_alias"
+                probe = fallback_probe
+        if executable and probe is None:
+            probe_args = [executable, "--version"] if name != "choco" else [executable, "--version"]
+            probe = _run(probe_args)
+        available = bool(executable and probe and probe["exit_code"] == 0)
+        managers[name] = {
+            "name": name,
+            "path_lookup": path_lookup,
+            "discovery": discovery if available else "none",
+            "executable": _redact(executable) if available else "없음",
+            "probe": probe,
+            "available": available,
+        }
+    return managers
+
+
+def _package_id(manager: str, stdout: str, candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    """패키지 관리자의 기계 판독 가능한 출력에서 패키지 ID를 읽는다."""
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return matches[0] if matches else None
+    if manager == "choco":
+        for line in stdout.splitlines():
+            package_id = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip()
+            if package_id.lower() == candidate.lower():
+                return package_id
+        return None
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        package_name = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if package_name.lower() == candidate.lower():
+            return package_name
+    return None
+
+
+def _query_command(manager: str, executable: str, candidate: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [
+            executable,
+            "search",
+            "--query",
+            candidate,
+            "--source",
+            "winget",
+            "--accept-source-agreements",
+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", candidate, "--exact", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", candidate]
+

+def _invocation_executable(display_executable: str) -> str:
+    if LOCAL_APPDATA:
+        return display_executable.replace("%LOCALAPPDATA%", LOCAL_APPDATA)
+    return display_executable

+def _query_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict) -> dict:
+    """기존 로컬 패키지 관리자에서 SAT 후보별 회답을 반환한다."""
+    rows = {}
+    for candidate in SAT_CANDIDATES:
+        queries = []
+        selected = None
+        for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+            if not manager_row["available"]:
+                continue
+            executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+            args = _query_command(manager, executable, candidate)
+            result = _run(args)
+            package_id = _package_id(manager, result["stdout"], candidate)
+            query = {
+                "manager": manager,
+                "command": result["command"],
+                "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
+                "stdout": result["stdout"],
+                "stderr": result["stderr"],
+                "package_id": package_id,
+                "available": result["exit_code"] == 0 and package_id is not None,
+            }
+            queries.append(query)
+            if selected is None and query["available"]:
+                selected = query
+        rows[candidate] = {
+            "package_queries": queries,
+            "available": selected is not None,
+            "package_manager": selected["manager"] if selected else None,
+            "package_id": selected["package_id"] if selected else None,
+        }
+    return rows

+# 증거 부록
+
+## A. 로컬 패키지 관리자
+
+작업 디렉토리의 `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`은 `C:/Users/.../dag-wt/pvsnp-탐사-1+2.6`을 반환했다. `where.exe` 세 호출은 모두 exit 1이다. PATH 밖 `winget.exe --version`은 exit 0과 `v1.29.280`을 반환했다.
+
+## B. 후보별 조회
+
+`minisat`는 `winget` exit 0과 패키지 ID `PolarGoose.minisat`를 받았다. `cadical`, `kissat`, `cryptominisat`은 각각 exit 2316632084와 패키지 ID 부재를 받았다.
+
+## C. 설치 시도와 재측정
+
+`winget install --id PolarGoose.minisat --exact --source winget`은 exit 0이다. 설치 후 실행 파일 경로를 재탐색했다. SAT는 exit 10, UNSAT는 exit 20이어서 `PASS`다. 명령·대상·관리자·패키지 ID·stdout·stderr는 `I-SAT-MINISAT`에 있다.
+
+## D. 증거 종류 경계
+
+라이브 로그 3건의 `environment_change`, `recorded_event`, I-PY, I-Z3, I-CMS, I-SAT 검색은 0건이다. `environment-changes.json`은 I-PY, I-Z3, I-CMS, I-SAT-MINISAT 4건만 갖는다.
+
+## E. TDD RED·GREEN
+
+RED: `python experiments/pvsnp/smoke/test_toolchain_smoke.py` → exit 1. `NotImplementedError`, 사건 파일 부재, 라이브 로그의 `environment_change` 존재를 관찰했다.
+
+GREEN: 같은 명령 → exit 0, `Ran 8 tests in 22.797s`, `OK`. 추가 구조 교차검사는 `STRUCTURE_OK`를 출력했다.
+
+## F. CLI·재생성·안전 검사
+
+`python experiments/pvsnp/smoke/toolchain_smoke.py --json`은 exit 0이고 JSON 파싱을 통과했다. `python experiments/pvsnp/smoke/toolchain_smoke.py --evidence-dir experiments/pvsnp/smoke/evidence`는 exit 0이다. 대상 7파일의 크리덴셜·개인 경로·이메일 패턴 검색은 0건이다. `dag_check.py`는 exit 0과 `무발견`을 반환했다.

+def _local_package_managers() -> dict:
+    """PATH 탐색과 실행 가능한 승인 별칭 경로를 분리해 반환한다."""
+    managers = {}
+    for name in ("winget", "choco", "scoop"):
+        path_lookup = _run(["where.exe", name])
+        executable = None
+        discovery = "none"
+        probe = None
+        if path_lookup["exit_code"] == 0 and path_lookup["stdout"]:
+            executable = path_lookup["stdout"].splitlines()[0]
+            discovery = "PATH"
+        elif name == "winget" and WINGET_FALLBACK.is_file():
+            fallback_probe = _run([str(WINGET_FALLBACK), "--version"])
+            if fallback_probe["exit_code"] == 0:
+                executable = str(WINGET_FALLBACK)
+                discovery = "windowsapps_alias"
+                probe = fallback_probe
+        if executable and probe is None:
+            probe_args = [executable, "--version"] if name != "choco" else [executable, "--version"]
+            probe = _run(probe_args)
+        available = bool(executable and probe and probe["exit_code"] == 0)
+        managers[name] = {
+            "name": name,
+            "path_lookup": path_lookup,
+            "discovery": discovery if available else "none",
+            "executable": _redact(executable) if available else "없음",
+            "probe": probe,
+            "available": available,
+        }
+    return managers
+
+
+def _package_id(manager: str, stdout: str, candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    """패키지 관리자의 기계 판독 가능한 출력에서 패키지 ID를 읽는다."""
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return matches[0] if matches else None
+    if manager == "choco":
+        for line in stdout.splitlines():
+            package_id = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip()
+            if package_id.lower() == candidate.lower():
+                return package_id
+        return None
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        package_name = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if package_name.lower() == candidate.lower():
+            return package_name
+    return None
+
+
+def _query_command(manager: str, executable: str, candidate: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [
+            executable,
+            "search",
+            "--query",
+            candidate,
+            "--source",
+            "winget",
+            "--accept-source-agreements",
+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", candidate, "--exact", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", candidate]
+

+def _invocation_executable(display_executable: str) -> str:
+    if LOCAL_APPDATA:
+        return display_executable.replace("%LOCALAPPDATA%", LOCAL_APPDATA)
+    return display_executable

+def _query_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict) -> dict:
+    """기존 로컬 패키지 관리자에서 SAT 후보별 회답을 반환한다."""
+    rows = {}
+    for candidate in SAT_CANDIDATES:
+        queries = []
+        selected = None
+        for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+            if not manager_row["available"]:
+                continue
+            executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+            args = _query_command(manager, executable, candidate)
+            result = _run(args)
+            package_id = _package_id(manager, result["stdout"], candidate)
+            query = {
+                "manager": manager,
+                "command": result["command"],
+                "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
+                "stdout": result["stdout"],
+                "stderr": result["stderr"],
+                "package_id": package_id,
+                "available": result["exit_code"] == 0 and package_id is not None,
+            }
+            queries.append(query)
+            if selected is None and query["available"]:
+                selected = query
+        rows[candidate] = {
+            "package_queries": queries,
+            "available": selected is not None,
+            "package_manager": selected["manager"] if selected else None,
+            "package_id": selected["package_id"] if selected else None,
+        }
+    return rows

 TOOL_ROOT = Path(LOCAL_APPDATA) / "pvsnp-toolchain"
 Z3_FALLBACK = TOOL_ROOT / "z3-5.1.0" / "z3-5.1.0-x64-win" / "bin" / "z3.exe"
 CMS_FALLBACK = TOOL_ROOT / "cryptominisat-5.14.7" / "cryptominisat5.exe"

+SAT_CANDIDATES = ("minisat", "cadical", "kissat", "cryptominisat")

+def _local_package_managers() -> dict:
+    """PATH 탐색과 실행 가능한 승인 별칭 경로를 분리해 반환한다."""
+    managers = {}
+    for name in ("winget", "choco", "scoop"):
+        path_lookup = _run(["where.exe", name])
+        executable = None
+        discovery = "none"
+        probe = None
+        if path_lookup["exit_code"] == 0 and path_lookup["stdout"]:
+            executable = path_lookup["stdout"].splitlines()[0]
+            discovery = "PATH"
+        elif name == "winget" and WINGET_FALLBACK.is_file():
+            fallback_probe = _run([str(WINGET_FALLBACK), "--version"])
+            if fallback_probe["exit_code"] == 0:
+                executable = str(WINGET_FALLBACK)
+                discovery = "windowsapps_alias"
+                probe = fallback_probe
+        if executable and probe is None:
+            probe_args = [executable, "--version"] if name != "choco" else [executable, "--version"]
+            probe = _run(probe_args)
+        available = bool(executable and probe and probe["exit_code"] == 0)
+        managers[name] = {
+            "name": name,
+            "path_lookup": path_lookup,
+            "discovery": discovery if available else "none",
+            "executable": _redact(executable) if available else "없음",
+            "probe": probe,
+            "available": available,
+        }
+    return managers
+
+
+def _package_id(manager: str, stdout: str, candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    """패키지 관리자의 기계 판독 가능한 출력에서 패키지 ID를 읽는다."""
+    if manager == "winget":
+        matches = re.findall(r"\b[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\.[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b", stdout)
+        return matches[0] if matches else None
+    if manager == "choco":
+        for line in stdout.splitlines():
+            package_id = line.split("|", 1)[0].strip()
+            if package_id.lower() == candidate.lower():
+                return package_id
+        return None
+    for line in stdout.splitlines():
+        package_name = line.strip().split(maxsplit=1)[0] if line.strip() else ""
+        if package_name.lower() == candidate.lower():
+            return package_name
+    return None
+
+
+def _query_command(manager: str, executable: str, candidate: str) -> list[str]:
+    if manager == "winget":
+        return [
+            executable,
+            "search",
+            "--query",
+            candidate,
+            "--source",
+            "winget",
+            "--accept-source-agreements",
+            "--disable-interactivity",
+        ]
+    if manager == "choco":
+        return [executable, "search", candidate, "--exact", "--limit-output"]
+    return [executable, "search", candidate]
+
+
+def _invocation_executable(display_executable: str) -> str:
+    if LOCAL_APPDATA:
+        return display_executable.replace("%LOCALAPPDATA%", LOCAL_APPDATA)
+    return display_executable
+
+
+def _query_sat_candidates(local_package_managers: dict) -> dict:
+    """기존 로컬 패키지 관리자에서 SAT 후보별 회답을 반환한다."""
+    rows = {}
+    for candidate in SAT_CANDIDATES:
+        queries = []
+        selected = None
+        for manager, manager_row in local_package_managers.items():
+            if not manager_row["available"]:
+                continue
+            executable = _invocation_executable(manager_row["executable"])
+            args = _query_command(manager, executable, candidate)
+            result = _run(args)
+            package_id = _package_id(manager, result["stdout"], candidate)
+            query = {
+                "manager": manager,
+                "command": result["command"],
+                "exit_code": result["exit_code"],
+                "stdout": result["stdout"],
+                "stderr": result["stderr"],
+                "package_id": package_id,
+                "available": result["exit_code"] == 0 and package_id is not None,
+            }
+            queries.append(query)
+            if selected is None and query["available"]:
+                selected = query
+        rows[candidate] = {
+            "package_queries": queries,
+            "available": selected is not None,
+            "package_manager": selected["manager"] if selected else None,
+            "package_id": selected["package_id"] if selected else None,

-`toolchain_smoke.py`는 매 실행에서 import와 실행 파일을 다시 호출한다. `test_toolchain_smoke.py`는 후보 전건, 명령, exit code, stdout·stderr, 로그 생성을 검사한다. 3절부터 5절까지의 판정표가 적은 버전·스모크·상태 값은 매 실행에서 다시 잰 결과이고 고정 fixture가 아니다. 2절 환경 변경 표의 exit code와 결과, 그리고 `pip check`의 exit code는 `toolchain_smoke.py`가 원시 로그의 `environment_change` 필드에 상수로 적어 두는 값이며 매 실행에서 다시 재지 않는다.
+`toolchain_smoke.py`는 매 실행에서 import, 패키지 관리자, 후보별 조회, 실행 파일을 다시 호출한다. `collect_report()`와 `--json`은 같은 객체를 쓴다. `sat-solvers.txt`는 같은 solver 행을 쓴다. 세 라이브 로그는 과거 사건을 담지 않는다. `environment-changes.json`만 과거 사건을 담는다.

 class ToolchainSmokeTest(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_path_invisible_winget_uses_only_executable_windowsapps_alias(self):
+        def fake_run(args, **_kwargs):
+            command = [str(value) for value in args]
+            if command[:2] == ["where.exe", "winget"]:
+                return {"command": "where.exe winget", "exit_code": 1, "stdout": "", "stderr": "not found"}
+            if command[-1] == "--version":
+                return {"command": "winget.exe --version", "exit_code": 0, "stdout": "v1", "stderr": ""}
+            return {"command": " ".join(command), "exit_code": 1, "stdout": "", "stderr": "not found"}
+
+        fallback = mock.Mock()
+        fallback.is_file.return_value = True
+        fallback.__str__ = mock.Mock(return_value="C:\\WindowsApps\\winget.exe")
+        with mock.patch.object(toolchain_smoke, "_run", side_effect=fake_run), mock.patch.object(
+            toolchain_smoke, "WINGET_FALLBACK", fallback
+        ):
+            managers = toolchain_smoke._local_package_managers()
+        winget = managers["winget"]
+        self.assertEqual("windowsapps_alias", winget["discovery"])
+        self.assertTrue(winget["available"])
+        self.assertEqual(1, winget["path_lookup"]["exit_code"])
+        self.assertEqual(0, winget["probe"]["exit_code"])
+
+    def test_candidate_queries_have_complete_structure_and_derive_availability(self):
+        managers = {

+                "available": True,
+                "executable": "winget.exe",

+            "cryptominisat": "No package found matching input criteria.",
+        }
